turnerclassicmovies.us.title: A Midsummer Night's Dream
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Shakespeare's Puck (Mickey Rooney) and forest fairies prompt a triple mortal wedding, with entertainment by Bottom (James Cagney). - 1935

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Dames
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A chorus girl (Joan Blondell), producer (Dick Powell) and dancer (Ruby Keeler) put on a Broadway show. Choreographed by Busby Berkeley. - 1934

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Gold Diggers of 1933
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A songwriter's (Dick Powell) big check puts chorus girls (Joan Blondell, Ruby Keeler) to work but incurs his brother's wrath. - 1933

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: 42nd Street
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A Broadway producer (Warner Baxter) sends in the understudy (Ruby Keeler) when his show's star (Bebe Daniels) twists her ankle. - 1933

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Footlight Parade
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A director (James Cagney) creates and stages extravagant musical prologues for movie theaters. - 1933

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Arsenic and Old Lace
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A theater critic (Cary Grant) learns his two elderly aunts serve poisoned elderberry wine to lonely gentlemen callers. - 1944

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: State of the Union
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Aircraft tycoon Grant Matthews (Spencer Tracy) is goaded into running for president by his politically ambitious longtime girlfriend, newspaper publisher Kay Thorndyke (Angela Lansbury). At the suggestion of unscrupulous campaign manager Spike McManus (Van Johnson), Matthews reunites with his long-estranged wife, Mary (Katharine Hepburn), for the sake of appearances. But when the idealistic Mary learns of Kay's behind-the-scenes role, it throws the entire campaign into turmoil. (Comedy drama) - 1948

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Ladies of Leisure
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Wealthy artist Jerry Strong (Ralph Graves) offers a lift to Kay Arnold (Barbara Stanwyck), a weary woman rowing a boat in the river. Despite Kay's confession that she is a call-girl, Jerry finds her striking and asks her to pose for him. During the sessions, Jerry's partying best friend, Bill Standish (Lowell Sherman), admires Kay and makes a play for her. Kay declines Bill's invitation to go away with him, having fallen for Jerry -- only to have Jerry's scandalized, stuffy parents intrude. (Comedy drama) - 1930

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Mr. Deeds Goes to Town
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Longfellow Deeds (Gary Cooper), a resident of small-town Vermont, leads a simple life until he inherits a vast fortune from a late uncle. Soon, unscrupulous lawyer John Cedar (Douglas Dumbrille) brings Deeds to New York City, where the unassuming heir is the object of much media attention. When wily reporter Babe Bennett (Jean Arthur) gains the trust and affection of Deeds, she uses her position to publish condescending articles about him -- but are her feelings for him really that shallow? (Comedy) - 1936

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Small Town Girl
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Kay Brannan (Janet Gaynor) loathes her boring hometown and jumps at the opportunity to spend time with Robert Dakin (Robert Taylor), a wealthy playboy visiting from Boston. They wake up after a drunken night to find that they're married, despite Robert's pre-existing engagement to a socialite. In order to protect Robert's reputation, his parents insist that they wait six months before a divorce. During that time, Kay must wrestle with Robert's bitter fiancée as well as her feelings for him. (Romantic comedy) - 1936

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Strawberry Blonde
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: At the turn of the century, dentist Biff Grimes (James Cagney) recalls his association with politician Hugo Barnstead (Jack Carson). The men meet over their romantic rivalry for striking strawberry blonde Virginia Brush (Rita Hayworth). Despite Biff's efforts, Virginia pushes her friend, nurse and women's rights advocate Amy Lind (Olivia de Havilland), on him and elopes with Hugo. After Biff and Amy fall in love, Biff joins Hugo's firm, only to learn that his rival is still a double dealer. (Romantic comedy) - 1941

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Flower Drum Song
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In this adaptation of the 1958 Rodgers and Hammerstein Broadway musical, Chinese immigrant Mei Li (Miyoshi Umeki) is betrothed to nightclub boss Sammy Fong (Jack Soo), but he wants to marry showgirl Linda Low (Nancy Kwan). To get out of the arrangement, Sammy pawns her off to wealthy Master Wang (Benson Fong) as a fiancée for his son, Wang Ta (Victor Sen Yung). Mei Li falls in love with Wang, but he wants to pursue Linda, who takes advantage of his affections to test Sammy's love. (Musical comedy) - 1961

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Camelot
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: After the arranged marriage of Arthur (Richard Harris) and Guinevere (Vanessa Redgrave), the king gathers the noble knights of the realm to his Round Table. The dashing and stalwart Lancelot (Franco Nero) joins, but soon finds himself enraptured by the lovely Guinevere. When Arthur's illegitimate son, Mordred (David Hemmings), reappears in the kingdom and outs the secret lovers, Arthur finds himself trapped by his own rules into taking action against his wife and closest friend. (Musical) - 1967

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: An American in Paris
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Jerry Mulligan is an American ex-GI who stays in post-war Paris to become a painter, and falls for the gamine charms of Lise Bouvier. However, his paintings come to the attention of Milo Roberts, a rich American heiress, who is interested in more than just art. (Musical, Romance) - 1951

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Top Hat
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The story centers on wealthy Dale Tremont (Ginger Rogers), on holiday in London and Venice. She assumes that American entertainer Jerry Travers (Fred Astaire) is the husband of her friend Madge (Helen Broderick) -- who's actually the wife of Jerry's business manager Horace Hardwick (Edward Everett Horton). (Musical, Romance) - 1935

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: West Side Story
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A musical in which a modern day Romeo and Juliet are involved in New York street gangs. On the harsh streets of the upper west side, two gangs battle for control of the turf. The situation becomes complicated when a gang member falls in love with a rival's sister. (Musical) - 1961

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Places in the Heart
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In 1935 rural Texas, recently widowed Edna Spalding struggles to survive with two small children, a farm to run and very little money in the bank -- not to mention a deadly tornado and the unwelcome presence of the Ku Klux Klan. Edna is aided by her beautician sister, Margaret; a blind boarder, Mr. Will; and a would-be thief, Moze, who decides to stick around to teach Edna how to plant and harvest cotton. (Drama) - 1984

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Absence of Malice
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Megan Carter is a reporter duped into running an untrue story on Michael Gallagher, a suspected racketeer. He has an alibi for the time his supposed crime was committed, but it involves an innocent party. When she tells Carter the truth and the newspaper runs it, tragedy follows, forcing Carter to face up to the responsibilities of her job when she is confronted by Gallagher. (Drama) - 1981

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Smokey and the Bandit
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Big Enos (Pat McCormick) wants to drink Coors at a truck show, but in 1977 it was illegal to sell Coors east of the Mississippi River without a permit. Truck driver Bo "Bandit" Darville (Burt Reynolds) agrees to pick up the beer in Texas and drive it to Georgia within 28 hours. When Bo picks up hitchhiker Carrie (Sally Field), he attracts the attention of Sheriff Buford T. Justice (Jackie Gleason). Angry that Carrie will not marry his son, Justice embarks on a high-speed chase after Bandit. (Comedy) - 1977

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Hooper
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Sonny Hooper (Burt Reynolds) is getting too banged up to remain Hollywood's top stuntman, but he signs up as the stunt coordinator for a big-budget action movie with a pushy director (Robert Klein) and a clueless star (Adam West). Ready to retire from the physical abuse, Hooper is gearing up to make the film's climactic stunt his biggest ever, but cocky young stuntman Ski Chinski (Jan-Michael Vincent) aims to steal the glory with his more scientific, technology-oriented stunt methods. (Action) - 1978

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Murphy's Romance
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Emma (Sally Field), a divorced single mother seeking to start her life over, moves to a small town in Arizona. She builds a relationship with Murphy (James Garner), the older local pharmacist but, due to his age, it remains platonic. Their friendship becomes complicated when Emma's ex-husband, Bobby Jack (Brian Kerwin), shows up. He claims to have changed his ways, but when he turns out to be the same man Emma divorced, she discovers her true feelings for Murphy. (Romantic comedy) - 1985

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Doughboys
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Elmer (Buster Keaton) is a privileged and affluent young man who has never wanted for a thing in his whole life. Then he falls for a beautiful USO performer named Mary (Sally Eilers), who finds his lack of concern for his fellow man deeply appalling. After Elmer mistakenly enlists in the military, he is offered a second chance with this lovely lady, though he has some stiff competition in the form of the suave and tough Sgt. Brophy (Edward Brophy). (Comedy) - 1930

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Speak Easily
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Thanks to his butler (Jimmy Durante), a professor (Buster Keaton) thinks he has inherited a fortune and lives it up. (Comedy) - 1932

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Passionate Plumber
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A woman of Paris (Irene Purcell) poses a plumber (Buster Keaton) as her lover to make her boyfriend jealous. (Comedy) - 1932

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Free and Easy
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: When Elvira (Anita Page) wins a beauty contest in her home state of Kansas, her clumsy manager, Elmer Butts (Buster Keaton), must take her to Hollywood for a chance at movie stardom. Forbidden to access the studios, Elvira and Elmer attend a film premiere and ogle at the many stars. In desperation, Elmer breaks onto a movie set -- and despite bumbling onto various active sets, wins a part as an extra. Meanwhile, Elvira attracts the attention of handsome film star Larry (Robert Montgomery). (Comedy) - 1930

actionmax.us.title: Batman Returns
actionmax.us.description: The Caped Crusader (Michael Keaton) clashes with Catwoman (Michelle Pfeiffer) and saves gloomy Gotham City from the foul Penguin's (Danny DeVito) plot. - 1992

actionmax.us.title: Batman Forever
actionmax.us.description: The Caped Crusader (Val Kilmer) woos a criminal psychologist, takes on a sidekick and battles Two-Face (Tommy Lee Jones) and the Riddler (Jim Carrey). - 1995

actionmax.us.title: Batman & Robin
actionmax.us.description: Batgirl joins the caped crusaders (George Clooney, Chris O'Donnell) to stop Mr. Freeze (Arnold Schwarzenegger) and Poison Ivy from wreaking revenge upon the world. - 1997

actionmax.us.title: Joker
actionmax.us.description: Isolated, bullied and disregarded by society, failed comedian Arthur Fleck begins a slow descent into madness as he transforms into the criminal mastermind known as the Joker. - 2019

actionmax.us.title: Joker: Folie à Deux
actionmax.us.description: Struggling with his dual identity, failed comedian Arthur Fleck stumbles upon true love while incarcerated at Arkham State Hospital. Awaiting trial for the murder of five people, Fleck soon discovers the music that's always been inside him. - 2024

actionmax.us.title: Birds of Prey (and the Fantabulous Emancipation of One Harley Quinn)
actionmax.us.description: It's open season on Harley Quinn when her explosive breakup with the Joker puts a big fat target on her back. Unprotected and on the run, Quinn faces the wrath of narcissistic crime boss Black Mask, his right-hand man, Victor Zsasz, and every other thug in the city. But things soon even out for Harley when she becomes unexpected allies with three deadly women -- Huntress, Black Canary and Renee Montoya. (Action, Comedy) - 2020

actionmax.us.title: The Whistlers
actionmax.us.description: A Romanian police officer, determined to free from prison a crooked businessman who knows where a mobster's money is hidden, must learn the difficult ancestral language used on the island of Gomera. (Comedy drama, Thriller) - 2019

actionmax.us.title: Grudge Match
actionmax.us.description: Pittsburgh boxers Billy "The Kid" McDonnen (Robert De Niro) and Henry "Razor" Sharp (Sylvester Stallone) shared a fierce rivalry back in the 1980s. Each had scored a victory in two matches, but on the eve of their decisive third bout, Henry suddenly announced his retirement, effectively ending both boxers' careers. Thirty years later, boxing promoter Dante Slate Jr. (Kevin Hart) makes Billy and Henry an offer they can't refuse: Return to the ring and settle the score once and for all. (Comedy) - 2013

actionmax.us.title: Girls Trip
actionmax.us.description: Best friends Ryan, Sasha, Lisa and Dina are in for the adventure of a lifetime when they travel to New Orleans for the annual Essence Festival. Along the way, they rekindle their sisterhood and rediscover their wild side by doing enough dancing, drinking, brawling and romancing to make the Big Easy blush. (Comedy, Drama, Adventure) - 2017

actionmax.us.title: Wedding Crashers
actionmax.us.description: Jeremy (Vince Vaughn) and John (Owen Wilson) are divorce mediators who spend their free time crashing wedding receptions. For the irrepressible duo, there are few better ways to drink for free and bed vulnerable women. So when Secretary of the Treasury William Cleary (Christopher Walken) announces the wedding of his daughter, the pair make it their mission to crash the high-profile event. But their game hits a bump in the road when John locks eyes with bridesmaid Claire (Rachel McAdams). (Romantic comedy) - 2005

actionmax.us.title: Space Jam: A New Legacy
actionmax.us.description: Superstar LeBron James and his young son, Dom, get trapped in digital space by a rogue AI. To get home safely, LeBron teams up with Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck and the rest of the Looney Tunes gang for a high-stakes basketball game against the AI's digitized champions of the court -- a powered-up roster called the Goon Squad. (Children, Comedy, Adventure, Fantasy, Animated) - 2021

actionmax.us.title: Nerve
actionmax.us.description: Industrious high school senior Vee Delmonico (Emma Roberts) is tired of living life on the sidelines. Pressured by her friends, Vee decides to join Nerve, a popular online game that challenges players to accept a series of dares. It's not long before the adrenaline-fueled competition requires her to perform increasingly dangerous stunts. When Nerve begins to take a sinister turn, Vee finds herself in a high-stakes finale that will ultimately determine her entire future. (Thriller, Action, Adventure, Crime drama) - 2016

actionmax.us.title: Black Butterfly
actionmax.us.description: On the outskirts of a mountain town grappling with a series of abductions and murders, Paul, a reclusive writer, struggles to start what he hopes will be a career-saving screenplay. After a tense encounter with a drifter named Jack, Paul offers Jack a place to stay. Soon, the edgy, demanding Jack muscles his way into Paul's work. As a storm cuts off power to the isolated cabin, the two men begin a jagged game that will bring at least one tale to an end. (Thriller) - 2017

actionmax.us.title: Aniara
actionmax.us.description: When a spacecraft carrying settlers to Mars strays off course, the consumption-obsessed passengers are prompted to consider their place in the universe. (Science fiction, Drama) - 2018

actionmax.us.title: Body at Brighton Rock
actionmax.us.description: Wendy, a part-time summer employee at a mountainous state park, takes on a rough trail assignment at the end of the season, trying to prove to her friends that she's capable enough to do the job. When she takes a wrong turn and ends up deep in the backcountry, she stumbles upon what might be a potential crime scene. Stuck with no communication after losing her radio and with orders to guard the site, Wendy must fight the urge to run. (Thriller) - 2019

actionmax.us.title: Horizon: An American Saga: Chapter 1
actionmax.us.description: In 1859 families discover the lure of the Old West as they settle in territories from Wyoming to Kansas. Meanwhile, a gruff cowboy soon finds himself on the run with a prostitute and a young boy after killing a fellow gunman. (Western, Drama) - 2024

actionmax.us.title: The Alto Knights
actionmax.us.description: In the 1950s, notorious New York crime bosses Frank Costello and Vito Genovese vie for control of the city streets. Once the best of friends, petty jealousies and a series of betrayals place them on a deadly collision course that reshapes organized crime forever. (Crime drama) - 2025

actionmax.us.title: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
actionmax.us.description: Godzilla and the almighty Kong face a colossal threat hidden deep within the planet, challenging their very existence and the survival of the human race. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2024

actionmax.us.title: Tomb Raider
actionmax.us.description: Lara Croft is the fiercely independent daughter of an eccentric adventurer who vanished years earlier. Hoping to solve the mystery of her father's disappearance, Croft embarks on a perilous journey to his last-known destination -- a fabled tomb on a mythical island that might be somewhere off the coast of Japan. The stakes couldn't be higher as Lara must rely on her sharp mind, blind faith and stubborn spirit to venture into the unknown. (Adventure, Action, Fantasy) - 2018

actionmax.us.title: Shot Caller
actionmax.us.description: Recently released from prison, a gang member finds himself forced by his leaders to orchestrate a major crime with a rival gang. (Crime drama, Thriller) - 2017

actionmax.us.title: A Good Day to Die Hard
actionmax.us.description: New York City cop John McClane (Bruce Willis) arrives in Moscow to track down his estranged son, Jack (Jai Courtney). McClane thinks his son is a criminal, so it comes as a shock when he learns that Jack is actually working undercover to protect Komarov (Sebastian Koch), a Russian government whistleblower. With their own lives on the line, McClane and Jack must overcome their differences in order to get Komarov to safety and thwart a potentially disastrous crime in the Chernobyl region. (Action, Thriller) - 2013

actionmax.us.title: Man Down
actionmax.us.description: When U.S. Marine Gabriel Drummer (Shia LaBeouf) returns from Afghanistan, he finds the place he once called home is no better than the battlefields he fought on overseas. Accompanied by his best friend, a hard-nosed Marine whose natural instinct is to shoot first and ask questions later, Gabriel searches desperately for his estranged son and his wife, leading to a suspect who has vital information about their location. (Thriller, Drama) - 2015

actionmax.us.title: Smoking Tigers
actionmax.us.description: Lonely 16-year-old Korean American Hayoung tries to hide her problematic family and lower-income background from her new wealthy friends. (Drama) - 2023

actionmax.us.title: The Return of Godzilla
actionmax.us.description: Okumura witnesses a huge monster during a storm. Biologist Hayashida hears Okumura's story from Toto Nippo reporter Maki and concludes that Godzilla, who was buried 30 years ago, has come back to life. Godzilla then appears in Tokyo Bay. (Science fiction) - 1984

actionmax.us.title: The Hitcher
actionmax.us.description: While transporting a car from Chicago to San Diego, Jim Halsey (C. Thomas Howell) picks up a hitchhiker named John Ryder (Rutger Hauer), who claims to be a serial killer. After a daring escape, Jim hopes to never see Ryder again. But when he witnesses the hitchhiker murdering an entire family, Jim pursues Ryder with the help of truck-stop waitress Nash (Jennifer Jason Leigh), pitting the rivals against each other in a deadly series of car chases and brutal murders. (Thriller) - 1986

actionmax.us.title: Epic
actionmax.us.description: Mary Katherine (Amanda Seyfried), or M.K., is a headstrong, spirited teenager who has a strained relationship with her father (Jason Sudeikis). She loses patience with her dad's tales of unseen people who live in the woods, but when she is magically transported to that mythic realm, she gains new perspective. M.K. joins a race of beings known as the Leafmen in their battle to protect their queen (Beyoncé Knowles) from their enemies, evil Mandrake (Christoph Waltz) and his crew of Boggans. (Animated, Children, Adventure, Action, Comedy) - 2013

The half-hour program covers many aspects of farming to give producers the information they need to make better decisions about their operations. The show's not just about agriculture, though, as it also features regular segments that deal with topics such as food safety, health news, and the people and places of rural America. Anchor Clinton Griffiths leads the show's on-air team. (News, Agriculture)

moremax.us.title: Robin Hood
moremax.us.description: In twelfth-century England, Robin Longstride and his band of marauders confront corruption in a local village and lead an uprising against the crown that will forever alter the balance of power. - 2010

moremax.us.title: The Hangover Part II
moremax.us.description: Hoping to avoid the mayhem that marked his friend's Las Vegas bachelor party, Stu opts for what he thinks will be a safe prewedding brunch in Thailand. - 2011

moremax.us.title: The Daytrippers
moremax.us.description: Family members (Pat McNamara, Anne Meara) join a woman (Hope Davis) on an odyssey to confront her husband about a love letter addressed to him. - 1996

moremax.us.title: Rampage
moremax.us.description: When three different animals become infected with a dangerous pathogen, a primatologist and a geneticist team up to stop them from destroying Chicago. - 2018

moremax.us.title: Shazam!
moremax.us.description: Billy Batson is a streetwise 14-year-old who can magically transform into the adult superhero Shazam simply by shouting out one word. His newfound powers soon get put to the test when he squares off against the evil Dr. Thaddeus Sivana. - 2019

moremax.us.title: Shazam! Fury of the Gods
moremax.us.description: Bestowed with the powers of the gods, Billy Batson and his fellow foster kids are still learning how to juggle teenage life with their adult superhero alter egos. When a vengeful trio of ancient gods arrives on Earth in search of the magic stolen from them long ago, Shazam and his allies get thrust into a battle for their superpowers, their lives, and the fate of the world. (Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy) - 2023

moremax.us.title: Twin Peaks: Fire Walk With Me
moremax.us.description: In the folksy town of Deerfield, Wash., FBI Agent Desmond (Chris Isaak) inexplicably disappears while hunting for the man who murdered a teen girl. The killer is never apprehended, and, after experiencing dark visions and supernatural encounters, Agent Dale Cooper (Kyle MacLachlan) chillingly predicts that the culprit will claim another life. Meanwhile, in the similarly cozy town of Twin Peaks, hedonistic beauty Laura Palmer (Sheryl Lee) hangs with lowlifes and seems destined for a grisly fate. (Crime drama) - 1992

moremax.us.title: Smoking Tigers
moremax.us.description: Lonely 16-year-old Korean American Hayoung tries to hide her problematic family and lower-income background from her new wealthy friends. (Drama) - 2023

moremax.us.title: Trap
moremax.us.description: A man and his teenage daughter realize they're at the center of a dark and sinister event while watching a concert. (Thriller) - 2024

moremax.us.title: Epic
moremax.us.description: Mary Katherine (Amanda Seyfried), or M.K., is a headstrong, spirited teenager who has a strained relationship with her father (Jason Sudeikis). She loses patience with her dad's tales of unseen people who live in the woods, but when she is magically transported to that mythic realm, she gains new perspective. M.K. joins a race of beings known as the Leafmen in their battle to protect their queen (Beyoncé Knowles) from their enemies, evil Mandrake (Christoph Waltz) and his crew of Boggans. (Animated, Children, Adventure, Action, Comedy) - 2013

moremax.us.title: Once Were Brothers: Robbie Robertson and The Band
moremax.us.description: The story of a band that went from backing up Bob Dylan to becoming one of the most influential groups of its era. (Music) - 2019

moremax.us.title: Colette
moremax.us.description: After moving to Paris, author Sidonie-Gabrielle Colette agrees to ghostwrite a semi-autobiographical novel for her husband. Its success soon inspires her to fight for creative ownership and overcome the societal constraints of the early 20th century. (Biography, Historical drama) - 2018

moremax.us.title: Miss Sloane
moremax.us.description: Willing to bend the rules for her clients, Elizabeth Sloane (Jessica Chastain) remains one of the most sought-after lobbyists in Washington, D.C. When asked to help oppose a bill that imposes regulations on firearms, she instead joins a scrappy boutique firm that represents the backers of the law. Her defiant stance and determination to win now makes her the target of powerful new enemies who threaten her career and the people she cares about. (Drama, Thriller) - 2016

moremax.us.title: Three Billboards Outside Ebbing, Missouri
moremax.us.description: After months have passed without a culprit in her daughter's murder case, Mildred Hayes makes a bold move, painting three signs leading into her town with a controversial message directed at William Willoughby, the town's revered chief of police. When his second-in-command, Officer Dixon -- an immature mother's boy with a penchant for violence -- gets involved, the battle is only exacerbated. (Crime drama, Dark comedy) - 2017

moremax.us.title: Spring Breakers
moremax.us.description: College students Candy (Vanessa Hudgens), Faith (Selena Gomez), Brit (Ashley Benson) and Cotty (Rachel Korine) are short of the cash they need for a spring-break trip, so they rob a diner and head down to Florida. However, the police soon break up the party and arrest them. The curvaceous quartet is unexpectedly bailed out by a drug dealer and aspiring rap artist named Alien (James Franco). Soon after, three of the four gal pals decide to join Alien in a life of crime. (Comedy, Crime drama) - 2012

moremax.us.title: Lady Bird
moremax.us.description: A teenager (Saoirse Ronan) navigates a loving but turbulent relationship with her strong-willed mother (Laurie Metcalf) over the course of an eventful and poignant senior year of high school. (Comedy drama) - 2017

moremax.us.title: Life of Pi
moremax.us.description: After deciding to sell their zoo in India and move to Canada, Santosh and Gita Patel board a freighter with their sons and a few remaining animals. Tragedy strikes when a terrible storm sinks the ship, leaving the Patels' teenage son, Pi, as the only human survivor. However, Pi is not alone; a fearsome Bengal tiger has also found refuge aboard the lifeboat. As days turn into weeks and weeks drag into months, Pi and the tiger must learn to trust each other if both are to survive. (Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Mystery) - 2012

moremax.us.title: Ghost Dog: The Way of the Samurai
moremax.us.description: Ghost Dog (Forest Whitaker) is a contract killer, a master of his trade who can whirl a gun at warp speed and moves through this world like a phantom -- stealthy and evanescent. In the spirit of the samurai, he has pledged his loyalty to a small time mobster named Louie (John Tormey) who saved his life many years before. (Crime drama) - 1999

moremax.us.title: Hall Pass
moremax.us.description: Best friends Rick and Fred each have been married for a long time, and they are showing signs of restlessness. To revitalize their marriages, their wives grant them one week to do whatever they please, no questions asked. At first, the deal sounds like a dream come true, but as the week marches on, the two friends discover that their expectations are wildly out of sync with reality. (Comedy) - 2011

moremax.us.title: MacGruber
moremax.us.description: In the decade since his fiancée was killed, an Army Ranger, Green Beret and Navy SEAL rolled into one has sworn off fighting crime, preferring instead to rock his mullet as a man of peace. But when his sworn enemy, Dieter Von Cunth, steals a nuclear warhead, only MacGruber and his crack team of experts are equal to the task of bringing the villain to justice. (Comedy, Action) - 2010

moremax.us.title: The Player
moremax.us.description: Certain that the anonymous threats he's been receiving are the work of David Kahane (Vincent D'Onofrio), producer Griffin Mill (Tim Robbins) tries to fix things over cocktails. Instead, Griffin ends up murdering the screenwriter and courting the dead man's girlfriend (Greta Scacchi). As police investigate, Griffin concentrates on a prestigious film that might reinvigorate his career. But he soon learns that David's demise hasn't been forgotten by everyone in Hollywood. (Comedy) - 1992

moremax.us.title: Aftermath
moremax.us.description: Two strangers' lives become inextricably bound together after an error by an air traffic controller (Scoot McNairy) causes the death of a construction foreman's (Arnold Schwarzenegger) wife and daughter. (Thriller, Drama, Action) - 2017

moremax.us.title: Chasing Mavericks
moremax.us.description: When 15-year-old surfing phenomenon Jay Moriarty discovers that the mythic Mavericks surf break, one of the biggest waves on Earth, actually exists near his California home, he becomes determined to conquer it. Jay enlists the aid of local surfing legend Frosty Hesson to train him to ride the Mavericks and live to tell about it. As Jay and Frosty carry on their quest to achieve the impossible, they develop a unique friendship that transforms both their lives. (Docudrama, Adventure) - 2012

moremax.us.title: Brian Banks
moremax.us.description: The inspirational true story of Brian Banks, an all-American high school football star who finds his life upended when he's wrongly convicted of a crime he didn't commit. Despite the lack of evidence, Banks gets railroaded through a broken justice system and sentenced to a decade of prison and probation. Years later, with the support of Justin Brooks and the California Innocence Project, Banks fights to reclaim his life and fulfill his dreams of playing in the NFL. (Biography, Drama) - 2018

moremax.us.title: Nerve
moremax.us.description: Industrious high school senior Vee Delmonico (Emma Roberts) is tired of living life on the sidelines. Pressured by her friends, Vee decides to join Nerve, a popular online game that challenges players to accept a series of dares. It's not long before the adrenaline-fueled competition requires her to perform increasingly dangerous stunts. When Nerve begins to take a sinister turn, Vee finds herself in a high-stakes finale that will ultimately determine her entire future. (Thriller, Action, Adventure, Crime drama) - 2016

moremax.us.title: William Shakespeare's Romeo & Juliet
moremax.us.description: Baz Luhrmann helped adapt this classic Shakespearean romantic tragedy for the screen, updating the setting to a post-modern city named Verona Beach. In this version, the Capulets and the Montagues are two rival gangs. Juliet is attending a costume ball thrown by her parents. Her father Fulgencio Capulet has arranged her marriage to the boorish Paris as part of a strategic investment plan. Romeo attends the masked ball and he and Juliet fall in love. natgeo.ca.title: Cesar Millan: Better Human Better Dog
natgeo.ca.description: Renowned dog behaviorist Cesar Millan comes back not only to rehabilitate dogs, but to train pet parents as well. With empty shelters and dog adoptions at a record high, his return to television gives new pet parents the tools they need to teach their dogs good habits and shed the bad ones. In addition, he helps pet parents better understand the connection that dogs have with their humans, and how people's actions can influence just how well, or poorly, their dogs behave. From the yards of the pet owners to his newly updated Dog Psychology Center, Cesar demonstrates the skills needed to create happy homes with furry best friends while equipped with a can-do attitude. (Animals, Pets, Reality) - 2021

sbssydney.au.title: Bollywed
sbssydney.au.description: S1 E5 Location! Location! Location! The hunt for a second location is on but the burbs are a bust when the family clash on what will make the best location.

sbssydney.au.title: Bollywed
sbssydney.au.description: S1 E6 Everyone Loves A Party Mom and Dad hope nostalgia will keep the kids from leaving the store when the Festival of South Asia makes its return.

sbssydney.au.title: NITV News: Nula ᴺᵉʷ
sbssydney.au.description: E41 Episode 41 The latest news from the oldest living culture, join Natalie Ahmat and the team of NITV journalists for stories from an Indigenous perspective.

sbssydney.au.title: Plat Du Tour
sbssydney.au.description: S4 E10 Potato And Leek Chilled Vichyssoise With Horseradish Cream Chaine des Puys, an area made up of around 80 dormant volcanoes that borders the city of Vichy. Guillaume creates his upscale version of Vichyssoise, with horseradish cream and a touch of caviar.

sbssydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
sbssydney.au.description: S8 E86 Gather Around It's time to gather around, as urban gardener Connie Cao and chef Alastair McLeod join Adam to make food that's best for sharing.

sbssydney.au.title: The Art Of Henna: A Journey To Freedom
sbssydney.au.description: In Rajasthan, three young women challenge traditional expectations through the art of mehndi. Their stories reveal determination, creativity and a desire for greater independence and opportunity.

sbssydney.au.title: Jeopardy!
sbssydney.au.description: S42 E170 Episode 170 Ken Jennings hosts Jeopardy! Where the answers are revealed, and the contestants must guess the appropriate questions.

sbssydney.au.title: Letters And Numbers
sbssydney.au.description: S4 E81 Episode 81 Two contestants pit their linguistic and numerical skills against each other and the clock in this entertaining quiz show.

sbssydney.au.title: Mastermind Australia
sbssydney.au.description: S5 E70 Episode 70 In this final round, the four reigning champions from this cycle battle it out to progress to the semi-finals.

sbssydney.au.title: SBS World News ᴺᵉʷ
sbssydney.au.description: E310 Episode 310 Latest reports and analysis of major national and international news of the day from Australia's only world news service.

sbssydney.au.title: Hotel Portofino
sbssydney.au.description: S1 E6 Denouements As the mystery of the missing heirloom is resolved, proposals and critical decisions are made, and Cecil attempts a reconciliation with Bella.

sbssydney.au.title: Summer In The Isles Of Scilly
sbssydney.au.description: S1 E2 Episode 2 Life on the Isles of Scilly unfolds as students prepare for the summer break, conservationists track blue sharks and islanders await a closely watched election result.

sbssydney.au.title: Queens That Changed The World
sbssydney.au.description: S2 E5 The Divisive Queen: Mary Queen Of Scots Arguably history's most divisive female ruler, crowned as a baby, Mary Queen of Scots reign was turbulent to the end.

sbssydney.au.title: SBS World News Late ᴺᵉʷ

sbssydney.au.title: Helsinki Syndrome
sbssydney.au.description: S1 E4 Tuesday As the hostage situation's backstory goes global, Elias Karo's plan advances with a crucial hack. Hanna Raivio starts to believe his claims, while a distracted Jarmo Kiiski gives Elias his chance.

sbssydney.au.title: Darkness: Those Who Kill
sbssydney.au.description: S4 E1 Episode 1 When a young gang member is shot dead shortly after his release from prison, criminal profiler Louise Bergstein and her partner Frederik Havgaard are drawn into a dangerous and complex case.

sbssydney.au.title: Darkness: Those Who Kill
sbssydney.au.description: S4 E2 Episode 2 Forensic evidence links two murders to the same killer. As the investigation deepens, a long-forgotten gang-related case resurfaces - and Louise commits herself fully to tracking down the killer.

sbssydney.au.title: Wisting
sbssydney.au.description: S2 E1 Episode 1 Detective William Wisting and his team suffer a terrible blow when a crime scene inspection with serial killer Tom Kerr goes horribly wrong.

sbssydney.au.title: Wisting
sbssydney.au.description: S2 E2 Episode 2 Wisting tries to unite the team after the tragedy that has struck them. He's forced to cooperate with Special Investigator Stiller in the hunt for the mysterious accomplice called 'The Other'.

sbssydney.au.title: Fragile Black Heart
sbssydney.au.description: Fragile Black Heart, a documentary by veteran photographer Lucy Di Paolo offers readers and viewers a glimpse into the other-worldly environment of the NSW outback mining town, Lightning Ridge.

sbssydney.au.title: Legacy List With Matt Paxton
sbssydney.au.description: S5 E4 Home At Last After spending years taking care of her family a woman finally gets the chance to move into a dream house of her own. The problem is she only has a week to move.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 Jokkmokk, Sweden Far above the Arctic Circle, Tareq explores the wild country around Jokkmokk.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lidia's Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E23 The Vegetable Patch Lidia works in her garden; she reminisces the lessons that her grandma taught her about her vegetable patch. She makes a country salad as well as green beans with new potatoes.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Cheese Slices
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E7 USA Will Studd visits the finest cheese shops in down town New York to find out what's driving this extraordinary change, before visiting upstate Vermont, where he meets a new generation of cheese makers.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Food Trail South Africa
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E3 Wild Kwa-Zulu Natal The wild northeast coast of South Africa is like nothing you've seen. And it's here Warren will find himself romanced by empty beaches, rugged open oceans, and waterways filled with wild hippopotamus.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Dolce Vita Riviera
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E8 Santa Margherita Ligure Santa Margherita Ligure reveals itself as a town where life is enjoyed at every hour of the day. Luana happily loses herself in its lively streets, discovering one of Liguria's most beloved tradition.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S6 E5 Karlstad: Food From Two Seasons Tareq visits sunny Karlstad! Here, food is prepared by Vanern's shores and in Varmland's deep forests. Butter-fried Zander, crepes and cooking over an open fire are on the menu.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Kriol Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E5 Maria Morgan: Ox Tail Stew & Vegie Bake Marie Morgan draws on the Kimberley history of station and mission days. Marie shares with us a family recipe that takes us back to a simpler time.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook And The Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E14 An Autumn Party Maggie introduces Simon to her outdoor wood-fired oven, and he uses it to make some pottery with a very special meal inside. Autumn is Maggie's favourite season.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E28 Episode 28 Laura uses local Adelaide Hills produce to make her delicious Red Wine Poached Pears. Chef Charlie Carrington and farmer Catherine Velisha join forces to showcase spring onions with a unique Za'atar.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E28 Albanian Pizza With Muscles And Pasta Rachael's friends, Leida and Veina, are showing how to make three types of Albanian Pizza, a rustic dish made with phyllo dough filled with beef, chicken, and potatoes.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E5 Little Manly Point Hayden sets up the BBQ in the park at Little Manly Point and has a tasty range of dishes ready to go: butterflied chicken, salmon flatbreads, and rotisserie mushrooms.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Not Your Butter Chicken
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 Ready To Roti This episode centres on the resilience of South Asian women throughout the hardships of migration.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E23 Episode 23 Laura makes some muesli bars and spaghetti alla Nerano; chef Masa cooks some seafood yaki udon; Catherine makes kangaroo salad.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Good Food Everyday With Gary Mehigan
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 Episode 3 Guest Paul Mercurio presents flavour-packed recipes including lamb backstraps with artichokes and capers, open pita with grilled haloumi, and roasted lamb rack.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E85 Have A Go Eco-entrepreneur Lottie Dalziel and Chef of the Year Jo Barrett join Adam to demonstrate how to have a go at their favourite food fundamentals.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Mary Makes It Easy
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E4 Some Like It Hot Hot sauce hive unite! Mary spices it up with recipes that bring the heat, including maple sriracha salmon and spicy pickled Caesar beans.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lidia's Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E24 Fruits And Sweets In the summer, it was time to wait for the fruits in Lidia's trees to ripen. She prepares a fig and prosciutto bruschetta, wafer cookies into truffles, and make almond tarts from Andria.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Cheese Slices
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E1 Cheeses Of Greece The ancient Greeks regarded cheese as Food of the Gods, and it's no surprise that in Greece today, the consumption of cheese per head of population is the highest in the world.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Food Trail South Africa
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E4 Madikwe Safari In this episode, Warren experiences the abundance of wildlife here, centering his experience around tracking and finding the elusive and endangered African Wild Dog.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Dolce Vita Riviera
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E9 Rapallo Rapallo keeps its secrets well. Behind its tranquil appearance lies a town full of delightful surprises. Luana begins by ascending to the Sanctuary of Montallegro.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E4 Bergen, Norway Bergen is a thousand-year-old city built on the back of the seafood trade especially cod.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Kriol Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E6 Bo Carne: Nana's Half Caste Stew & Magpie Goose Giblet & Heart Blachan Everyone has a stew they can brag about. In this episode, Bo Carne shares his Nana's version of the good old billabong stew.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook And The Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E15 Autumn Fruit And Nuts Its Autumn and the new seasons array of Fruit and Nuts sees Maggie and Simon whip up a collection of captivating flavours. For Maggie, Autumn means Vintage in the Barossa.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E29 Episode 29 Laura's mum, Anita, joins her in the kitchen with a quick family favourite, Zucchini Pasta. Guest host Shane Jolley teams up with Chef Mod to cook an Asian classic, Seared Salmon in Massaman Curry.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E29 Cacciatore With Jeremy Sisto Actor and family friend Jeremy Sisto joins Rachael in her Tuscan kitchen to learn how to make Hunter's Chicken, known in Italy as Cacciatore served with generous helpings of bruschetta.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E6 Little Manly Beach The BBQ is setup on the pier overlooking Little Manly on a perfect day for Hayden's recipes: Portuguese chicken burgers, tarte Tatin, and mushroom-stuffed salmon.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Not Your Butter Chicken
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 Darkness To Light This episode, filmed during the festival of light known as Diwali, focuses on the new era of Indo-Canadians rewriting the script on family as they celebrate a fresh take on cultural traditions.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E24 Episode 24 Laura & Daen prepare a baked snapper with salsa verde; Heather makes kake soba with fish cakes & onsen eggs; Tobie Puttock cooks raspberry chia jam cooked on renewable gas; Catherine puts together a Dominican traditional soup with a twist.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Good Food Everyday With Gary Mehigan
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E4 Episode 4 This episode highlights heart-healthy, diabetes-conscious recipes: T-bone steak with garlic and herb baste, a fetta and quinoa salad with cumin dressing, and Bò lá lôt.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E53 Episode 53 Have you ever folded your pizza in on itself? It is delicious!

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E86 Gather Around It's time to gather around, as urban gardener Connie Cao and chef Alastair McLeod join Adam to make food that's best for sharing.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Outback Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E4 Episode 4 Justine explores Darwin, visiting the Parap Markets and enjoys a beautiful breakfast laksa. She then joins MasterChef alumni Rachel Ciesiolka for a seafood cook-off at Rachel's Seafood Shack.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: A Girl's Guide to Hunting, Fishing and Wild Cooking
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E4 Episode 4 Conquering her fear of bees, Analiese gets her first beehive before heading off on an adventure of foraging, fishing and diving with best friend and famous Thai restaurateur, Palisa Anderson.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Paddock To Plate
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E8 The Kimberley As his journey concludes, Matt explores the vast Kimberley Region and it's spectacular coast. He cooks locally farmed barramundi, mud crab and pearl meat and travels to a cattle station for an end-of-muster feast.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Anthony Bourdain: A Cook's Tour
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E17 The French Laundry Experience Marooned in San Francisco, Tony tastes local shellfish and durian ice cream before embarking on a pilgrimage to experience the genius of Thomas Keller, chef, and owner of The French Laundry.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Anthony Bourdain: A Cook's Tour
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E18 Traditional Tastes Tony is invited to experience the culinary heart and distinct walled medinas (districts) of the Moroccan city Fez.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Mary Makes It Easy
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E5 Meat Cute Mary uses easier-on-your-wallet meat cuts to make flavourful dishes, like pork chops au poivre and her mom's signature grilled flank steak.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lidia's Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E25 Corn: From The Kernel To The Husk Today is all about corn. Recipes include a refreshing corn zucchini minestra, a polenta cacio e pere, and a mix of vegetables that can be served as a side dish - grilled corn, apricots, and portobello.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Cheese Slices
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E2 Basque Sheperds Cheeses Will visits the pretty village of Espelette to sample its red peppers, before travelling into the mountains to one of the few remaining traditional shepherds huts where where they milk ewe's by hand.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Food Trail South Africa
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E5 The Garden Route A true hidden gem of South Africa, the Garden Route is a 200km stretch of coastal highway known for its beguiling diversity and unparalleled spirit of wilderness.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Dolce Vita Riviera
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E10 Alassio In Alassio, everything seems effortlessly perfect. Warm smiles, timeless elegance, and culinary delights define this day dedicated to the pleasures of Riviera life.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E5 Malmo, Sweden Tareq is in his hometown of Malmo-Sweden's third largest city. Built upon the backs of herring in the sea, the town is now a centre of culture and technology with a bridge connecting it to Copenhagen.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Kriol Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E7 Helani Doolah: Sop Sop, Sabee Domboi, And Marinated Fried Fish With Battered Banana Using knowledge from her grandmother and other family members, Helani Doolah will show and teach us how to make some staple dishes that are made every day in the Torres Strait Islander community.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook And The Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E16 Autumn Fruit And Veg Simon takes some new seasons vegetables and shows us how to pickle ginger and daikon, while Maggie uses ginger to make an eggplant salad.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E30 Episode 30 Laura is in the market kitchen making the naughtiest donuts you'll ever see Nutella and Praline Donuts.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E30 Bacalao Con Pomodoro Rachael shows how to make Bacalao con Pomodoro, a dish inspired by an amazing meal she shared with John during a special trip to Elba, a Mediterranean island in Tuscany.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E7 Manly Cove Hayden starts the day with an early morning run with his running club, before he gets his BBQ on to serve up a glazed salmon side, hot pork rolls, and a mushroom and ricotta pizza.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Not Your Butter Chicken
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E4 What Will People Say Shiva looks inward and contemplates the impacts of living in fear of social judgment and a common reprimand of her childhood, \.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E25 Episode 25 Laura is visited by potato farmer Rene Pye who learns how to make a Chicken & Potato Curry for her family.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Good Food Everyday With Gary Mehigan
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E5 Episode 5 Featuring Arrnott Olsen, Gary turns to bright coastal flavours with a Fijian fish curry, hiramasa kingfish crudo, and South Indian fish moilee with South Indian red rice.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E54 Episode 54 If you haven't tried Dukkah, we encourage you to! Kate Weiss joins Justine and shows off her beautiful Dukkah Roasted Cauliflower Salad.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S5 E85 Festival Of Lights It's Easy Entertaining with The Cook Up, and Adam is celebrating Diwali, the festival of lights, with chefs Gunjan Aylawadi and Nagesh Seethiah.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Hotel Chocolat At Christmas
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Behind the scenes at Hotel Chocolat as they count down to Christmas. With the ambition to design, make and sell over 50 million chocolates this year, it's going to be a busy time for the team.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The World's Biggest Curry Restaurant
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: We're a nation that loves our curry. But in Greater Manchester, there's one venue that's bigger and bolder than all the rest-The Royal Nawaab.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Anthony Bourdain: A Cook's Tour
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E19 Portugal: Cod Crazy Tony travels to Porto, home of the famous Port wine, where he is immediately exposed to the codfish and the almost mythical place it holds in Portuguese cuisine and culture.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Anthony Bourdain: A Cook's Tour
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E20 San Sebastian: A Food Lover's Town Tony explores the food-crazed Basque culture. Tony's guide, Chef Luis Irizar, takes Tony into the underworld of Basque gastronomic societies. Later, Tony explores the city's tapas bars.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Taste Of The Tropics
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E2 Taste Of The Tropics: Foodie Friends Cairns chef Davy O'Rourke, who specialises in Mexican and South American cuisines, honours the tradition of his country of birth by cooking a Papua New Guinean mumu under the guidance of his mum.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E25 Gross and Smelly Lots of things in the garden seem a bit gross - compost, slugs, spider webs, poo, worms, but all have a purpose. And Costa will prove that the purpose is. beautiful!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Andy's Wild Workouts
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E5 Mountains Andy is off on a mountainous adventure and he wants you to come along too. On this adventure, Andy explores the highest points on Earth, climbing mountains in search of a grizzly bear.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Santiago of the Seas
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E55 Nacho Supreme Tomas's new pet friend, Nacho, shows off his special skills when the crew goes on a daring rescue mission to save Kiko.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Superkitties
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E3 Fireworks Fright Mr. Puppypaws steals all of Kittydale's fireworks.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Hey Duggee
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E4 The Camouflage Badge Cosey the chameleon teaches the Squirrels all about camouflage. However when Cosey loses his colour-changing ability, it's up to Duggee and the Squirrels to help him.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E50 Surprise Bluey and Bingo want Dad to play two different games, so Dad plays both at the same time.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S9 E47 Parachute Games Peppa and George have fun playing parachute games at playgroup with all their friends.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S9 E48 Flying Discs Peppa and George have a lovely day in the park with Mummy and Daddy learning how to throw and catch the flying discs.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Kiri and Lou
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E29 Meteors Lou warns everyone that meteorites are falling, while Small does her exercises.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Big Lizard
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E10 When We Lost D.O.R.I.S.'s Brain When a giant beetle steals D.O.R.I.S.'s brain, thinking it's a nut, Cosima and Big Lizard give chase through the forest. Big Lizard's unique skills rescue poor D.O.R.I.S.'s super-brain.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Octonauts
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E30 The Octonauts And The Giant Jelly The Octonauts must rescue Peso when he gets trapped inside a giant Comb Jelly!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Kangaroo Beach
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E2 Pounce on Patrol Wearing Bondi's cap, Pounce thinks he's chief lifeguard - but when Gemma and Neville need rescuing from a whale encounter, should he jump in, or alert a real lifeguard?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Super Monsters
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E10 Misadventures in Monster Sitting Esmie and Igor discover the joys and challenges of babysitting Sami, a playful baby yeti, in a night full of chaos and laughter.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Spidey and His Amazing Friends ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E12 Oh, No! Tomatoes! Miles can't let Rhino steal the tomatoes his mum grew for community dinner.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E1 Perfect Bluey's Father's Day card has to be perfect but she can't decide what to draw! So Mum reminds her about all the fun times she's had with Dad and how he's not so perfect either.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Flower & Flour
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E11 Spring Clean During a public holiday, Flower and Flour help Penny and Dirk, give the restaurant a spring clean. But the cleanup quickly turns into an epic game of castles, knights, and dragons.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E30 Pirate Treasure When Captain Squid leaves his treasure map in the Little Kingdom, Redbeard leads Ben, Holly and Nanny Plum on a treasure hunt. The map says the treasure is deep under water and guarded by a mermaid and a golden sea monster!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Piripenguins
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E10 Misty Mountain Mystery The Piris hike to Tippety Top to see the Southern lights but must brave an 'ice-fog'.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Supertato
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E12 Sweetieland Saga Supertato has built Chilli a massive funfair made from sweets. There's lots of fairground games, where he can win loads of floofy teddies!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Gardening Australia Junior
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E25 Gross and Smelly Lots of things in the garden seem a bit gross - compost, slugs, spider webs, poo, worms, but all have a purpose. And Costa will prove that the purpose is. beautiful!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E51 Daddy Putdown When Mum goes out to a baby shower, Dad takes charge of the girls' evening routine. But with Bluey missing Mum, Dad has to pull out all the games he knows to keep them entertained.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Shaun the Sheep
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S4 E8 The Rabbit The Farmer's niece has come to visit, bringing her pet rabbit. When the rabbit disappears Shaun and the Flock are called to action to help track down the illusive pet before the niece discovers it's missing.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Monkie Kid ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E2 A Hero Is Born Part: 2 MK finds Monkey King at the Flower Fruit Mountain and begs him to come and defeat the evil DBK who now terrorizes the city.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E19 Naughty or Ice Daphne brings the gang to a fancy Ice Hotel co-owned by her family where a new exhibit of ice age artifacts is opening. Things heat up, however, when a frozen Ice Man thaws out and goes on a rampage inside the hotel.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: BtN Newsbreak ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: E198 Find out what's going on in the world with a news bulletin designed for children, featuring stories that are relevant and easy to understand.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mr. Bean
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E33 Where Did You Get That Cat? Mr Bean is wracked with guilt after he chases Scrapper and ends up with a flattened cat.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mr. Bean
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E34 Valuable Lessons Mr Bean plays gooseberry when Mrs Wicket falls in love with a man Mr Bean doesn't trust.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Steven Universe ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E21 Beta Steven and Amethyst visit some friends in the country but Amethyst isn't being herself.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Steven Universe ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E22 Earthlings Amethyst tries to exact revenge with a showdown in the Kindergarten.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Steven Universe ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E23 Back to the Moon Steven and the Gems revisit the Moon Base.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Adventure Time
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S5 E1 Finn the Human After chasing the Lich through the portal, Finn and Jake meet a wishmaster named Prismo.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Adventure Time
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S5 E2 Jake the Dog Jake and Prismo watch from the portal as the Ice King's crown makes Finn more and more powerful.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Battlebots ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S7 E4 What The Flip? It's week two of the world championship season and the fight card is full of veteran favourites, hotshot rookies and carnage; among the highlights is End Game versus Blip.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Merlin
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E1 The Curse Of Cornelius Sigan New servant Cedric muscles in on Merlin's position as Arthur's right-hand man, and turns the prince against his loyal friend. Merlin is convinced the slippery newcomer is up to something, and he is right. Cedric is a conman.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Young Sheldon
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S6 E7 A Tougher Nut and a Note on File Sheldon's search for a comic book leads him to a breakthrough. Also, Georgie and Mandy have an uncomfortable first encounter with her parents, Jim and Audrey.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Young Sheldon
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S6 E6 An Ugly Car, an Affair and Some Kickass Football George Sr. is asked to help with the football team; Mandy discovers Georgie and Meemaw's secret business.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Pokemon: Ruby and Sapphire
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S7 E22 Disguise Da Limit The people of a small village blame a local drought on the Pokemon Solrock, but it soon comes to light that the drought is in fact the work of Team Rocket.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Dragon Ball Super
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E33 Surprise, 6th Universe! This Is Super Saiyan Goku! Goku faces the first fighter of the 6th Universe - Botamo. Things don't look good at the start when Goku struggles from overeating, but it's nothing a little stretching can't fix.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Miraculous: Tales Of Ladybug And Cat Noir
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E25 Heart Hunter (The Battle of the Miraculous (1) Ladybug and Cat Noir face the Bourgeois couple. Now Hearthunter, a Cerberus with two heads, they devour all the love in Paris.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: We Bare Bears
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E23 Family Troubles Baby Grizz lives on the set of a sitcom in which he stars.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Teen Titans Go!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E20 Thanksgiving Robin struggles to create the perfect Thanksgiving.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Teen Titans Go!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S6 E49 Bumgorf When the Titans realize they have not seen Silkie for a long time, they take turns guessing what happened.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Teen Titans Go!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S7 E5 A Little Help Please When they receive a distress call from the TTG animators and artists, the Titans must tone down their actions and avoid big adventures.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Total Dramarama
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E17 Dissing Cousins Pt.1 It's International Cousins Day and Owen and Gwen are dreading the fact that their cousins Max and Ella are spending the day with them. And soon, everyone else will understand why.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Powerpuff Girls
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E38 Man Up 4: The Donnyest Game With Man-Boy on the loose, Donny must be prepared for anything.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Malory Towers
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E19 The Voice Sally returns to a very different Malory Towers. They need to warn Miss Grayling of the strict new rules but they'll have to get through Miss Johnson first.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Operation Ouch!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S12 E3 In a Spin! Dr Xand gets in a spin to show you why you get dizzy, the Flying Doctors help a new baby in Australia and Dr Raph takes an icy dip when he meets a Brilliant Body who swims in the Antarctic.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The InBESTigators
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E5 The Case of the Sleepover Secret / The Case of the Big Mouth Challenge Pixie is furious when something she privately told Ava is made public, so Maudie resolves to find out how Pixie's secret got out.

BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E6 City of Death: Part 2 The Doctor and Romana become the reluctant guests of Scarlioni who is planning to steal the Mona Lisa despite having six Mona Lisas hidden in his cellar – all of them genuine.

BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E7 City of Death: Part 3 Count Scarlioni is revealed to really be Scaroth, last of the Jagaroth and is funding the construction of a time machine – but for what purpose?

BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E20 The Horns of Nimon: Part 4 On the dying world of Crinoth, Romana discovers the truth behind the Nimon’s empty promises. The Doctor must find a way to shut down the power complex on Skonnos.

BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E2 The Leisure Hive: Part 2 The Tachyon Recreation Generator is the cause of the mysterious deaths at the Leisure Hive. Romana makes repairs, and the Doctor becomes a reluctant guinea pig.

BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E3 The Leisure Hive: Part 3 The Tachyon Generator has aged the Doctor into a white haired old man, but he discovers the truth behind the machine and uncovers a plot to take control of the Hive.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E4 The Leisure Hive: Part 4 The obsessed Pangol is determined to give Argolis a future with himself as the leader of the reborn race and plans to strike back at the Foamasi.

BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E5 Meglos: Part 1 On Zolfa-Thura, Meglos plans to steal the ancient and powerful Dodecahedron from the neighbouring world of Tigella. But first, the Doctor must be prevented from interfering.

BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E6 Meglos: Part 2 Masquerading as the Doctor, Meglos penetrates the underground city of Tigella. The Doctor and Romana are trapped in an ever repeating circle of time and powerless to act.

oxygenwest.us.title: Accident, Suicide, or Murder
oxygenwest.us.description: S03 E03 Lover's Chair Investigators uncover a web of lies a decade after a couple's romantic evening atop Rockefeller Lookout in New Jersey ends with the wife's tragic death.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Secrets Uncovered
oxygenwest.us.description: S06 E01 The Sting Newlywed Dalia Dippolito returns home from the gym to the awful news that her husband had been killed; in a case where almost nothing is as it seems, investigators want to know if Dalia is diabolical or an unwitting pawn in a hoax gone wrong.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Secrets Uncovered
oxygenwest.us.description: S06 E02 Dark Valley When the dashing Gavin Smith vanishes, LA detectives are unsure if they are investigating a crime or a suicide; his wife claims he had gotten lost in drugs and flings; police wonder if the key to finding Gavin is hidden in one of those affairs.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Secrets Uncovered
oxygenwest.us.description: S06 E03 Black Friday Ashlea Harris has no shortage of admirers, so when she is found dead after a suspicious fire consumes her apartment, police are baffled; the fire is no accident but the clues to who killed Ashlea may be up in smoke.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Secrets Uncovered
oxygenwest.us.description: S06 E04 Out There In the Dark Brandy Daniels believes someone is stalking her, then the single mother is found slumped over in her car, shot dead; investigators spend years navigating the twists and turns searching for her killer.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Secrets Uncovered
oxygenwest.us.description: S06 E05 The Women & Dirty John Debra Newell thought she found Mr. Right, but her daughters sensed something wrong about John Meehan; they started digging into his past and their search for answers exposed a dangerous con man.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Secrets Uncovered
oxygenwest.us.description: S06 E06 As Night Fell Heidi and Conrad Truman are an enviable couple with a bright future until Heidi is found shot; in the aftermath, fingers are pointed but could be aimed at an innocent person.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Secrets Uncovered
oxygenwest.us.description: S06 E07 Good & Evil When a woman's body is discovered at a trash facility, a detective makes a promise to her mother to get justice; she doesn't know she will come face to face with a serial killer.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Secrets Uncovered
oxygenwest.us.description: S06 E08 Deadly Trust Wealthy residents feel safe in their gated community, but it is not safe for one millionaire, murdered in his waterfront home; police investigate, but the case grows cold; turns out the key to solving it, or two keys, is right at the front door.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Secrets Uncovered
oxygenwest.us.description: S06 E09 The Shadow The save the date cards had gone out; Angie Ver Huel went to sleep next to her fiancé, Justin Michael, with big dreams but woke up to a nightmare; someone was running from their bedroom and Justin was dead.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Secrets Uncovered
oxygenwest.us.description: S06 E10 Internal Affairs A beautiful, popular graduate student is shot dead outside her apartment in Durham, North Carolina.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Secrets Uncovered
oxygenwest.us.description: S06 E11 The Trap A murder occurs in an affluent neighborhood with tree-lined streets; investigators find a riddle, a deception and a piece of pure evil.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Secrets Uncovered
oxygenwest.us.description: S06 E12 Deadly Twist Todd Winkler claims self-defense after being arrested for killing his wife, Rachel; investigators travel to Georgia to find out how Todd's first wife died on a camping trip 10 years earlier.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Secrets Uncovered
oxygenwest.us.description: S07 E01 Devil's Bathtub Craig and Laura Rideout appear happy, but after they separate, an ugly secret is revealed and one of them will soon be dead; clues point to four possible killers and leave investigators wondering if this murder is all in the family.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline
oxygenwest.us.description: S07 E50 The Window A Florida father is determined to find out what happened to his daughter after her fatal fall from a penthouse apartment in Belgium.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline
oxygenwest.us.description: S07 E51 The Window A Florida father is determined to find out what happened to his daughter after her fatal fall from a penthouse apartment in Belgium.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline
oxygenwest.us.description: S04 E09 Circle of Friends A teen is killed by a bullet during a party and his friend loses his freedom to what he says is a lie.

oxygenwest.us.title: New York Homicide
oxygenwest.us.description: S03 E10 Abducted in Williamsburg In the midst of a blizzard, the abduction of a Hasidic man from his Williamsburg office sparks a desperate NYPD search; as more dark details emerge, discoveries of debts, betrayal and ties to the Russian mob send police on a mission for the truth.

oxygenwest.us.title: New York Homicide
oxygenwest.us.description: S03 E11 Bronx Undercover When a college student goes missing, a search of her Bronx apartment leads the NYPD to suspect foul play; the investigation stalls until a witness comes forward, prompting an undercover sting operation that blows the lid off a deadly conspiracy.

oxygenwest.us.title: New York Homicide
oxygenwest.us.description: S03 E12 Dangerous Work When prominent Latino journalist and activist Manuel de Dios Unanue is fatally shot at a Queens restaurant, a joint task force must figure out which of a long list of enemies, including some international terror groups, is behind his execution.

oxygenwest.us.title: Philly Homicide
oxygenwest.us.description: S02 E08 Dungeons, Dragons, and Death The stabbing murder of a 20-year-old woman in the suburbs of Philadelphia stymies detectives until a series of eerily similar murders six years later reveals a killer that has been hiding in plain sight all along.

oxygenwest.us.title: Philly Homicide
oxygenwest.us.description: S02 E09 Vanished in Plain Sight After a young mother mysteriously disappears, all of Philadelphia unites in their efforts to find her; but as police begin peeling away the layers of her life, they discover the truth behind what happened to her.

oxygenwest.us.title: Philly Homicide
oxygenwest.us.description: S02 E10 Killer in the Shadows The violent murder of a young newlywed in the outskirts of Philadelphia confounds investigators for decades until the perseverance of detectives, combined with new technology, reveals her killer was closer than anyone anticipated.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Unforgettable
oxygenwest.us.description: S02 E29 The Ranch Eduardo Valseca is taken hostage in an orchestrated abduction; Keith Morrison reflects on the family he spent years following; what happened to them might have destroyed many, but not the Valsecas.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Unforgettable
oxygenwest.us.description: S02 E30 What Happened to Amy? For more than 30 years, Ohio investigators have searched for answers in the murder of 10-year-old Amy Mihaljevic; the details of the case still haunt Josh Mankiewicz and investigators, who ask for help solving the crime.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Unforgettable
oxygenwest.us.description: S02 E31 The Secret of Spirit Lake An advocate for missing and murdered Indigenous women searches for answers in the disappearance of her niece and exposes cracks in law enforcement; Andrea Canning looks back on this important story, one that became her passion project.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Unforgettable
oxygenwest.us.description: S02 E32 The Plan A double homicide in upstate New York leads detectives on a cross-country investigation; Dennis Murphy reflects on a story full of twists and turns, including the surprising suspect at the center.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Unforgettable
oxygenwest.us.description: S02 E33 The Haunting The children of an Oklahoma pastor survive the robbery that took their parents' lives; it's a story Keith Morrison still can't forget, and one where the very best and worst of humanity are both on full display.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Unforgettable
oxygenwest.us.description: S02 E34 Internal Affairs When a popular graduate student is shot dead in Durham, N.C., detectives uncover a deadly love triangle; it takes a lot to surprise correspondent Josh Mankiewicz, but the claims are shocking.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Unforgettable
oxygenwest.us.description: S02 E35 Return to Manitowoc County It's a mystery that defies easy answers, and "Dateline" has been following it for more than a decade; Steven Avery and his teenage nephew were convicted of killing Teresa Halbach; now, Andrea Canning shares her insight into the controversial case.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Unforgettable
oxygenwest.us.description: S02 E36 Twisted When an Iowa woman is attacked while home alone with her three children, the confrontation turns deadly; Dennis Murphy examines one of the most sophisticated criminal plots of his "Dateline" career.

oxygenwest.us.title: Homicide for the Holidays
oxygenwest.us.description: S01 E01 A Deadly Thanksgiving A deranged shooter attacks a family Thanksgiving dinner, leaving four dead and even more wounded, setting off a massive holiday-season manhunt to catch the killer - before they can strike again.

oxygenwest.us.title: Homicide for the Holidays
oxygenwest.us.description: S02 E01 Thanks-killing Earl and Terry Robertson are found brutally murdered in their home just before Thanksgiving; investigating whether this is a holiday robbery gone terribly wrong, or a crime committed by someone the couple knew and trusted.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline
oxygenwest.us.description: S08 E18 What Happened in Vegas Part 1 A chance encounter on the Pacific Coast Highway with a woman he first spoke to in a jail cell leads Keith Morrison to reexamine the mysterious death of Las Vegas casino magnate Ted Binion.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline
oxygenwest.us.description: S08 E19 What Happened in Vegas Part 2 A chance encounter on the Pacific Coast Highway with a woman he first spoke to in a jail cell leads Keith Morrison to reexamine the mysterious death of Las Vegas casino magnate Ted Binion.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline
oxygenwest.us.description: S01 E128 The Disappearance of Debbie Hawk Debbie Hawk's three children arrive home to find their mother missing, with blood throughout the house; investigating who did this and why.

oxygenwest.us.title: The Real Murders of Atlanta
oxygenwest.us.description: S03 E06 Twice as Deadly A young mother in the quiet Atlanta hamlet of Buford is found shot to death in what detectives deem to be a staged suicide; as investigators search for leads, they uncover an eerily similar death linked to someone with close ties to both victims.

oxygenwest.us.title: The Real Murders of Atlanta
oxygenwest.us.description: S03 E11 Search for a Monster Atlanta's tight-knit Chinatown community is devastated when a beloved mother is discovered brutally murdered in an industrial parking lot; with few leads, the team discovers a cryptic note that leads them to a surprising killer.

oxygenwest.us.title: The Real Murders of Atlanta
oxygenwest.us.description: S04 E01 Officer Down When an officer is gunned down during a routine traffic stop, detectives work to bring justice to their fallen comrade; the team races against the clock to find the killer before he strikes again.

oxygenwest.us.title: The Real Murders of Atlanta
oxygenwest.us.description: S04 E02 When The Music Stops When an aspiring rapper is found dead during a shootout at the Metropolitan Studios in Atlanta, detectives must follow a trail of lies, ultimately discovering a cold-blooded betrayal at the heart of the murder.
