wdrb.us.description: This long-running animated comedy focuses on the eponymous family in the town of Springfield in an unnamed U.S. state. The head of the Simpson family, Homer, is not a typical family man. A nuclear-plant employee, he does his best to lead his family but often finds that they are leading him. The family includes loving, blue-haired matriarch Marge, troublemaking son Bart, overachieving daughter Lisa and baby Maggie. Other Springfield residents include the family's religious neighbor, Ned Flanders, family physician Dr. Hibbert, Moe the bartender and police chief Clancy Wiggum. (Animated, Sitcom) - 1989-12-17

wdrb.us.title: Young Sheldon
wdrb.us.description: For young Sheldon Cooper, it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naive Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son. For 12 years on "The Big Bang Theory," audiences came to know the iconic, eccentric and extraordinary Sheldon Cooper. In "Young Sheldon," audiences get a chance to meet him in childhood, as he embarks on his innocent, awkward and hopeful journey toward the man he will become. Jim Parsons, who plays the adult version of Sheldon on "The Big Bang Theory," narrates. (Sitcom) - 2017-09-25

wdrb.us.title: The Simpsons
wdrb.us.description: This long-running animated comedy focuses on the eponymous family in the town of Springfield in an unnamed U.S. state. The head of the Simpson family, Homer, is not a typical family man. A nuclear-plant employee, he does his best to lead his family but often finds that they are leading him. The family includes loving, blue-haired matriarch Marge, troublemaking son Bart, overachieving daughter Lisa and baby Maggie. Other Springfield residents include the family's religious neighbor, Ned Flanders, family physician Dr. Hibbert, Moe the bartender and police chief Clancy Wiggum. (Animated, Sitcom) - 1989-12-17

wdrb.us.title: Young Sheldon
wdrb.us.description: For young Sheldon Cooper, it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naive Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son. For 12 years on "The Big Bang Theory," audiences came to know the iconic, eccentric and extraordinary Sheldon Cooper. In "Young Sheldon," audiences get a chance to meet him in childhood, as he embarks on his innocent, awkward and hopeful journey toward the man he will become. Jim Parsons, who plays the adult version of Sheldon on "The Big Bang Theory," narrates. (Sitcom) - 2017-09-25

discoverywest.us.title: Forbidden History
discoverywest.us.description: S07 E03 Mary Magdalene Enigma Mary Magdalene played a pivotal role in early Christianity and witnessed the execution and resurrection of Jesus Christ; experts investigate the truth behind her mysterious disappearance and embark on a quest to locate her undiscovered remains.

discoverywest.us.title: Forbidden History
discoverywest.us.description: S07 E02 The Devil's Bible "The Codex Gigas," also known as the "Devil's Bible," is a giant medieval tome that has evoked fear for centuries and is believed to contain a malevolent power; experts investigate its legendary secrets and uncover the mystery behind its author.

discoverywest.us.title: Forbidden History
discoverywest.us.description: S07 E07 MK-Ultra Revealed The CIA's MK-Ultra program sought to create mind control methods through unethical human experimentation, and now, experts investigate classified documents that reveal the horrific atrocities that were carried out in the pursuit of national security.

discoverywest.us.title: Ghost Adventures
discoverywest.us.description: Village of Lost Souls The crew investigates reports of vicious paranormal attacks at LA's Heritage Square Museum; as the team explores this collection of Victorian homes, they suspect a dark portal is responsible for shadow figure sightings and poltergeist activity.

discoverywest.us.title: Ghost Adventures
discoverywest.us.description: Mentryville Ghost Town Zak and the crew venture to California's first oil boomtown to investigate reports of ghostly activity inside its buildings and glowing anomalies in the surrounding hills; chaos ensues as the guys attempt to unravel the mystery of Mentryville.

discoverywest.us.title: Ghost Adventures
discoverywest.us.description: King Gillette Ranch The crew visits King Gillette Ranch, a sprawling compound built on sacred land; its dark history plus a brush with a cult has birthed violent spirit activity that drains the living of their energy, making this the GAC's heaviest investigation yet.

discoverywest.us.title: Ghost Adventures
discoverywest.us.description: Fear in Flagstaff Zak and the crew check in for a night of terror at an Arizona hotel where guests and staff have reported troubling paranormal experiences for decades; the chaotic spirit is wreaking havoc, and the GAC may be the only ones who can help.

discoverywest.us.title: Expedition Unknown
discoverywest.us.description: Legend of the Snake King, Part 1 Archaeologist Dr. Richard Hansen joins Josh and his team to venture deep into the Guatemalan rainforest to find the hidden tombs of the mysterious Snake Kings in the ancient Mayan city of El Mirador.

discoverywest.us.title: Expedition Unknown
discoverywest.us.description: Legend of the Snake King Part 2 Josh concludes his investigation into the mysterious Mayan city of El Mirador, from the possible burial of the elusive Snake Kings to uncovering the secrets behind the fall of one of history's greatest ancient cities.

discoverywest.us.title: Expedition Unknown
discoverywest.us.description: S06 E05 Lost Gold of Scotland Hunting for a lost cache of gold, Josh Gates heads to the Scottish Highlands; his search focuses on a huge gold reserve hidden after the Jacobite Uprising of 1745 and never recovered; Josh joins treasure hunters chasing a lead across the Highlands.

discoverywest.us.title: Expedition Unknown
discoverywest.us.description: S06 E02 Deciphering the Last Nazi Code Josh Gates ventures into the former Third Reich in search of an elusive Nazi fortune hidden with a code allegedly created by Adolf Hitler's private secretary and embedded into a piece of sheet music.

discoverywest.us.title: Expedition Unknown
discoverywest.us.description: S13 E03 Traitors' Treasure of 1776 Josh chases the fortune stolen by loyalists to Britain's crown during the American Revolution; investigations of the infamous Doan Gang; Josh helps dig up a cache of plundered coins; a cave search pinpoints the turncoats' hideout.

discoverywest.us.title: Animals on Drugs

discoverywest.us.title: Animals on Drugs

Meanwhile, advertising exec Tony Kent (Randolph Scott) desperately searches for Rebecca, who he has only heard, unaware that she's on the farm next to his. Tony's search is interrupted by many things -- including Rebecca's attractive cousin, Gwen (Gloria Stuart). (Musical) - 1938

fxm.us.title: The Song of Bernadette
fxm.us.description: Based on the popular novel by Franz Werfel, this drama focuses on Bernadette Soubirous (Jennifer Jones), a young French woman who experiences vivid visions of the Virgin Mary. While many dismiss her claims, certain people, including the priest Dominique Peyramale (Charles Bickford), slowly begin to believe her. Eventually, Bernadette is deemed a saint, and becomes a nun at a convent, where she must deal with jealousy from others who resent her revered status. (Drama) - 1943

fxm.us.title: The Lodger
fxm.us.description: In London in 1889, retiree Robert Burton (Cedric Hardwicke) and his wife, Ellen (Sara Allgood), rent a spare room to the mysterious Slade (Laird Cregar) as Jack the Ripper continues to terrorize the city. The Burtons' niece, Kitty (Merle Oberon), is a music hall singer who initially grows fond of the eccentric lodger, but, when the Ripper's body count rises, she and a Scotland Yard inspector (George Sanders) gradually begin to suspect that Slade could be the notorious Whitechapel killer. (Thriller) - 1944

fxm.us.title: Leave Her to Heaven
fxm.us.description: While on a train, writer Richard Harland (Cornel Wilde) strikes up a relationship with the gorgeous Ellen Berent (Gene Tierney). Ellen quickly becomes obsessed with Richard and abandons her fiancé, Russell Quinton (Vincent Price), to be with him. The couple rushes into marriage, with both of them caught up in romance and Richard intrigued by Ellen's intensity. Only after settling into marriage, however, does Richard realize that she is psychotically jealous and highly unstable. (Crime drama) - 1945

fxm.us.title: The Terrorists

Tough Scandinavian operative Nils Tahlvik (Sean Connery) is sent in to deal with the armed men and free the aircraft's passengers. Unfortunately for Tahlvik, the terrorists prove to be quite formidable. Meanwhile, another unit of the same extremist organization is holding an English ambassador hostage, which further complicates matters. (Thriller, Crime drama) - 1974

fxm.us.title: Laura

On the trail of her murderer, McPherson quizzes Laura's arrogant best friend, gossip columnist Waldo Lydecker (Clifton Webb) and her comparatively mild fiancé, Shelby Carpenter (Vincent Price). More challenging for Diana is staying on the good side of motor-mouthed club owner Dollar Bill, avoiding the club's unsavory cast of characters and helping her newbie stripping cousin, Ebony, stay on the straight and narrow. (Comedy drama) - 1998

365blk.us.description: The plaintiff says she and the defendant broke up because he was unfaithful, and she's suing because he is more than $6,000 behind in child support. (Reality, Law) - 2018-05-11

5starmax.us.title: Godzilla vs. Gigan
5starmax.us.description: Godzilla and Anguirus fight three-headed dragon Ghidorah and huge bird Gigan at a cartoonist's theme park. - 1972

5starmax.us.title: Godzilla vs. Megalon
5starmax.us.description: Godzilla and flying cyborg Jet Jaguar meet a giant cockroach and a big black chicken sent by Seatopians. - 1973

5starmax.us.title: Godzilla vs. Mechagodzilla
5starmax.us.description: An Okinawan monster-god helps Godzilla defeat his bionic double. - 1974

5starmax.us.title: Dim Sum Funeral
5starmax.us.description: The grown children of an overbearing Chinese matriarch reluctantly gather to take part in seven days' worth of traditional funeral rites. - 2008

5starmax.us.title: The Last Emperor
5starmax.us.description: Named Emperor of China at age 3 in 1908, Pu Yi (John Lone) becomes a prisoner of destiny. - 1987

5starmax.us.title: Contagion
5starmax.us.description: The world panics as doctors race to find a cure for a rapidly spreading virus that kills those contaminated within days. - 2011

5starmax.us.title: Full Metal Jacket
5starmax.us.description: Stanley Kubrick's take on the Vietnam War follows smart-aleck Private Davis (Matthew Modine), quickly christened "Joker" by his foul-mouthed drill sergeant (R. Lee Ermey), and pudgy Private Lawrence (Vincent D'Onofrio), nicknamed "Gomer Pyle," as they endure the rigors of basic training. Though Pyle takes a frightening detour, Joker graduates to the Marine Corps and is sent to Vietnam as a journalist, covering -- and eventually participating in -- the bloody Battle of Hue. (War, Historical drama) - 1987

5starmax.us.title: A History of Violence
5starmax.us.description: When a pair of petty criminals attempt to rob his small-town diner, Tom Stall (Viggo Mortensen) quickly and easily kills them both. In the flush of news coverage of Tom's seemingly heroic actions, a threatening stranger named Carl Fogarty (Ed Harris) comes to town, fingering the unassuming family man as long-missing Philadelphia mobster Joey Cusack. To the horror of his wife, Edie (Maria Bello), and teenage son, Jack (Ashton Holmes), Tom finds he must confront his violent past. (Drama, Thriller) - 2005

5starmax.us.title: The Usual Suspects
5starmax.us.description: "The greatest trick the devil ever pulled was convincing the world he didn't exist," says con man Kint, drawing a comparison to the most enigmatic criminal of all time, Keyser Söze. Kint attempts to convince the feds that the mythic crime lord not only exists, but is also responsible for drawing Kint and his four partners into a multi-million dollar heist that ended with an explosion in San Pedro Harbor - leaving few survivors. (Thriller, Crime drama) - 1995

5starmax.us.title: Scanners
5starmax.us.description: Scanners are men and women born with incredible telepathic and telekinetic powers. There are many who exercise the benefits of their special gifts in a safe and judicious manner. However, there is a group of renegade scanners who plan to create a race that will rule the world. (Science fiction, Horror, Thriller) - 1981

5starmax.us.title: Fantastic Planet
5starmax.us.description: This animated tale follows the relationship between the small human-like Oms and their much larger blue-skinned oppressors, the Draags, who rule the planet of Ygam. While the Draags have long kept Oms as illiterate pets, this hierarchy shifts after an Om boy becomes educated, thanks to a young female Draag. This leads to an Om rebellion, which weakens the Draag control over their race. Will the Oms and the Draags find a way to coexist? Or will they destroy each other? (Animated, Science fiction) - 1973

5starmax.us.title: Head Office
5starmax.us.description: A U.S. senator's son (Judge Reinhold) gets a job at a conglomerate and falls for the chairman's (Eddie Albert) radical daughter. (Comedy) - 1986

5starmax.us.title: Odd Jobs
5starmax.us.description: The summer job situation looks bleak for five college pals until they decide to start their own moving business. (Comedy) - 1986

5starmax.us.title: Flashpoint
5starmax.us.description: Texas border patrolmen (Kris Kristofferson, Treat Williams) find a jeep, a skeleton and $800,000 in cash dating from 1963. (Action) - 1984

5starmax.us.title: Holla
5starmax.us.description: A mysterious killer stalks a sitcom actress (Shelli Boone) and her companions (Young Sir, Michael Bergin) on a weekend getaway in the wilderness. (Horror) - 2006

5starmax.us.title: Repo Men
5starmax.us.description: In the future, medical technology has advanced to the point where people can buy artificial organs to extend their lives. But if they default on payments, an organization known as the Union sends agents to repossess the organs. Remy (Jude Law) is one of the best agents in the business, but when he becomes the recipient of an artificial heart, he finds himself in the same dire straits as his many victims. With his former partner (Forest Whitaker) in hot pursuit, Remy runs for his life. (Science fiction, Action, Thriller) - 2010

5starmax.us.title: Blood Simple
5starmax.us.description: "Blood Simple" was the first feature film from Joel and Ethan Coen. This is the newly restored and re-edited director's cut of the film, introduced by Mortimer Young. The stylish crime thriller premiered at film festivals in 1984. "Blood Simple" begins deep in the heart of Texas, where a jealous saloon owner hires a cheap divorce detective to kill the saloon owner's younger wife and her bartender lover. But the detective gets a better idea. (Thriller, Crime drama) - 1984

5starmax.us.title: Rise of the Planet of the Apes
5starmax.us.description: Will Rodman, a scientist in San Francisco, is experimenting with a drug that he hopes will cure his father's Alzheimer's disease. After his work is deemed a failure, Will becomes the guardian of Caesar, an infant chimp who was exposed in utero to Will's drug. Caesar displays unusual intelligence, and Will decides to continue his experiments secretly. But as Caesar's intellect and abilities grow, he comes to represent a threat to man's dominion over Earth. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: The Blair Witch Project
5starmax.us.description: Found video footage tells the tale of three film students (Heather Donahue, Joshua Leonard, Michael C. Williams) who've traveled to a small town to collect documentary footage about the Blair Witch, a legendary local murderer. Over the course of several days, the students interview townspeople and gather clues to support the tale's veracity. But the project takes a frightening turn when the students lose their way in the woods and begin hearing horrific noises. (Horror, Thriller) - 1999

5starmax.us.title: Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2
5starmax.us.description: As it follows the twisted path traveled by five people fixated on "The Blair Witch Project," "Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2" journeys into a dark and dangerous place where the line between truth and fiction blurs and perhaps vanishes altogether. Individual perception grows increasingly untrustworthy as the film's protagonists find themselves caught in a vortex of unspeakable evil, the origins of which -- human or supernatural -- remain chillingly uncertain. (Adventure, Fantasy, Horror) - 2000

5starmax.us.title: Batman
5starmax.us.description: Having witnessed his parents' brutal murder as a child, millionaire philanthropist Bruce Wayne (Michael Keaton) fights crime in Gotham City disguised as Batman, a costumed hero who strikes fear into the hearts of villains. But when a deformed madman who calls himself The Joker (Jack Nicholson) seizes control of Gotham's criminal underworld, Batman must face his most ruthless nemesis ever while protecting both his identity and his love interest, reporter Vicki Vale (Kim Basinger). (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1989

5starmax.us.title: Batman Returns
5starmax.us.description: The monstrous Penguin (Danny DeVito), who lives in the sewers beneath Gotham, joins up with wicked shock-headed businessman Max Shreck (Christopher Walken) to topple the Batman (Michael Keaton) once and for all. But when Shreck's timid assistant, Selina Kyle (Michelle Pfeiffer), finds out, and Shreck tries to kill her, she is transformed into the sexy Catwoman. She teams up with the Penguin and Shreck to destroy Batman, but sparks fly unexpectedly when she confronts the caped crusader. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1992

5starmax.us.title: Batman Forever
5starmax.us.description: Batman (Val Kilmer) faces off against two foes: the schizophrenic, horribly scarred former District Attorney Harvey Dent, aka Two-Face (Tommy Lee Jones), and the Riddler (Jim Carrey), a disgruntled ex-Wayne Enterprises inventor seeking revenge against his former employer by unleashing his brain-sucking weapon on Gotham City's residents. As the caped crusader also deals with tortured memories of his parents' murder, he has a new romance, with psychologist Chase Meridian (Nicole Kidman). (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1995

5starmax.us.title: Batman & Robin
5starmax.us.description: This superhero adventure finds Batman (George Clooney) and his partner, Robin (Chris O'Donnell), attempting to the foil the sinister schemes of a deranged set of new villains, most notably the melancholy Mr. Freeze (Arnold Schwarzenegger), who wants to make Gotham into an arctic region, and the sultry Poison Ivy (Uma Thurman), a plant-loving femme fatale. As the Dynamic Duo contends with these bad guys, a third hero, Batgirl (Alicia Silverstone), joins the ranks of the city's crime-fighters. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1997

5starmax.us.title: Working Girls
5starmax.us.description: College graduate Molly (Louise Smith), trying to bankroll her own business, works as a high-priced New York City escort. As a lesbian, she's able to keep her emotional distance from the clients, who range from cynically exploitative to desperately needy. But her open ambition to rise above her current station rubs many of her coworkers the wrong way, especially the combative, street-smart Dawn (Amanda Goodwin) and the escort service's disdainful madam, Lucy (Ellen McElduff). (Drama) - 1986

bbcfood.us.title: Hairy Bikers' Bakeation
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E08 Spain Dave and Si journey through Spain and visit a traditional Basque dining club in San Sebastián.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Chocolate Chef Raymond Blanc creates four mouth-watering chocolate recipes: a simple mousse, rich chocolate delice, fondant with a melting middle, and his signature dessert: café crème, which is a chocolate-sculpted cup filled with a mousse and coffee sabayon.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Apples Chef Raymond Blanc looks to the UK's favorite fruit, apples, for inspiration; he returns to memories of childhood with a simple tart made with a foolproof pastry and custard filling.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Winter Vegetables Chef Blanc celebrates the season with a winter vegetable salad featuring beetroots, a celeriac purée served with a crisp-skinned roast wild duck with blackberry sauce and watercress soup.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Game and Mushrooms Chef Blanc uses two seasonal ingredients, game and mushrooms, to create a French version of a pasty called pithivier, which is filled with a rich mix of pheasant, chestnuts and dried fruits; he also makes a cep mushroom tortellini with fresh pasta.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Bread The miracle of yeast helps Raymond to create a French classic: brioche; he gets down to basics with a French country bread recipe that's essential for any baker to add to their repertoire; lastly, he makes a spectacular apple croustade.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E02 Cakes and Pastries Chef Raymond begins with a feather-light lemon tea cake, coated in an apricot jam and tangy lemon glaze; he also makes a choux pastry filled with chocolate cream and covered with a chocolate icing; lastly, the secrets to the perfect macarons.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E03 Lamb Chef Blanc shares his favorite lamb dishes: lamb liver with caramelized potatoes and French seasoning, a slow-roasted garlic and herb lamb shoulder with potato and turnip gratin and lamb Provencal with ratatouille.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E04 Pudding Raymond celebrates his passion for puddings, cooking dishes including riz au lait, tarte tatin and fruit crumble.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Suppers
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Leftovers Nigel starts off with the remains of the Sunday roast.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Suppers
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Winter Warmers Nigel makes comfort foods that hit the spot.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Suppers
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E01 New Tricks Nigel transforms classic recipes with some new twists.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Suppers
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E04 Too Good to Waste How to make simple, delicious feasts from ingredients that seem to have seen better days.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigellissima
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Nigella introduces her love of Italian food through a spectacular yet simple Sicilian pasta with tomatoes, garlic and almonds and a mid-week family feast of tagliata.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigellissima
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Nigella Lawson shares the secrets of her Italian roast chicken, served alongside a saffron orzotto; Nigella prepares coffee ice cream for dessert, inspired by the ice cream parlors of Florence; a chocolate olive oil cake provides an extra treat.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigellissima
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Episode 3 Pork loin stuffed with Parma ham and oregano, served alongside her speedy mock mash and lazy person's vignarola.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigellissima
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Liquorice pudding; Sardinian sun-dried and toasted couscous; butterflied leg of lamb; baby aubergines with oregano and roasted red onion.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigellissima
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Nigella starts with her take on a light and sunny yogurt pot cake; she recruits her niece and nephew to make a shortcut sausage meatball supper; Nigella prepares squid and prawns with marjoram and chili; a tiramisu ends the evening.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigellissima
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Episode 6 Lamb chops with mint; chilli and golden potatoes; ruby red plum and amoretti crumble; farro risotto with mushrooms.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E01 Shellfish Chef Blanc celebrates the best of British shellfish as he cooks dishes including Moules Marinière, seared squid salad and Scottish lobster.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E02 Cakes and Pastries Chef Raymond begins with a feather-light lemon tea cake, coated in an apricot jam and tangy lemon glaze; he also makes a choux pastry filled with chocolate cream and covered with a chocolate icing; lastly, the secrets to the perfect macarons.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E03 Lamb Chef Blanc shares his favorite lamb dishes: lamb liver with caramelized potatoes and French seasoning, a slow-roasted garlic and herb lamb shoulder with potato and turnip gratin and lamb Provencal with ratatouille.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E04 Pudding Raymond celebrates his passion for puddings, cooking dishes including riz au lait, tarte tatin and fruit crumble.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E05 Charcuterie Chef Raymond shares his love of charcuterie, beginning with thin slices of duck cured in herbs and juniper berries; also, he makes a chicken liver parfait and a meaty pot-au-feu medley; lastly, a ham hock terrine served with home-made pickles.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E06 Spices and Chillies Drawing upon his travels through Asia, Raymond creates dishes full of fragrant spice and fiery heat.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E07 Summer Fruits Raymond demonstrates the versatility of the summer's juiciest fruits with a simple but impressive berry-strewn pavlova and a spicy cherry clafoutis where the vibrant fruit is cushioned in a bed of soft, sumptuous pastry.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E08 Summer Greens Raymond celebrates the freshest summer greens, beginning with a simple yet vibrant pistou soup, laden with summer vegetables and bursting with basil, topped with crispy croutons and meltingly rich Parmesan.

buzzr.us.title: The Price Is Right
buzzr.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04

Neither likes the other much, but when coach Halas (Ben Gazzara) makes them the first interracial roommates in the NFL, the two gradually form a sincere friendship. Piccolo helps Sayers overcome an injury, and Sayers later gives Piccolo much needed support when he's diagnosed with terminal cancer. (Docudrama, Movie) - 2001-12-02

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Cook's Country - Chuck Roast and Potatoes
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Roasted beef chuck roast with horseradish parsley sauce; medicinal uses for horseradish; kitchen timers; torn and fried potatoes; creamed spinach.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Cook's Country - Biscuits and Chicken
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Butter and lard biscuits; the debate between lard and shortening; the benefits of full-sized and mini food processors; mimosa fried chicken.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Julia at Home - Summer Supper With Friends
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Grilled chicken; buttery grilled corn; Parmesan orzo salad; lemon pie.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Julia at Home - Favorite Fried Chicken
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Julia whips up her favorite fried chicken with slow-cooker buttermilk smashed potatoes, and quick collard greens with hot pepper vinegar.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Julia at Home - Chili With Cheesy Scones for a Crowd
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Black bean chili; jalapeño-cheddar scones; salad with orange vinaigrette; slow-cooker flan.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Cook's Country - Thanksgiving, Simplified
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: One-pan turkey breast and stuffing; dressing vs. stuffing debate; buying turkey; pear-cranberry chutney; roasted butternut squash and apple.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Cook's Country - Italian Comfort Food
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Cheesy stuffed shells; 13x9 broiler-safe baking dishes; eggplant pecorino.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Cook's Country - Italian-American Comforts
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Italian meatloaf; substitutes for fresh garlic; asparagus baked in foil; immigrant origins of scampi; chicken scampi.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Cook's Country - Bread, Cheese and Meat Can't Be Beat
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Sliders; ketchup; croque monsieur.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Julia at Home - Back to School Dinner
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Julia welcomes the start of the school year with one-pan, twin roast chickens plus root vegetables with tarragon vinaigrette and butterscotch pudding for dessert.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Julia at Home - Cast Iron: Morning, Noon and Night
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Julia makes everything in a cast iron from strata, paninis, teriyaki-style chicken thighs and apple fritters.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Julia at Home - Vegetarian Feast
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Stuffed portabello mushrooms; lemon and basil pasta; apple and radicchio salad; almond cake.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Cook's Country - Elevated Friendsgiving Mains
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Slow-roasted duck with blackberry sauce; the best uses for different tinned fish; a rich bean bourguignon.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Cook's Country - Short Ribs and Baked Potatoes
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Slow-roasted medium rare beef short ribs; beef steaks; a fun baked potato story; twice-baked potatoes with bacon and cheddar cheese.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Cook's Country - New England Sandwiches
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Jitto's-style steak bombs; types of squash; the origins of different sandwich names; eggplant spuckie.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Cook's Country - Darn Good Desserts
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: S'mores pie; rolling pins; M&M cookies.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Julia at Home - Comfort Food With a Twist
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Julia's take on comfort food includes thick-cut pork chops with smoked sea salt, garlic-scented mashed sweet potatoes with coconut milk and cilantro, a brussels sprouts and kale salad with herbs and peanuts, and her slow-cooker Nutella bread pudding.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Julia at Home - Davison House Burgers
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: It's burger night in the Davison house and Julia's got all the fixings: home ground beef, crispy home fries, and her all-time favorite condiment, homemade pickled onions.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Julia at Home - Chilaquiles for a Crowd
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Julia's weekend plans include her favorite cast-iron chicken chilaquiles with homemade hot sauce, refreshing micheladas, and restaurant-inspired fried ice cream cake.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Julia at Home
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Julia Collin Davison cooks in her home kitchen; she whips up test kitchen favorites and cooks from some of her recipe books, breathing new life into long-standing traditions. (Cooking, Educational) - 2020-12-31

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Cook's Country
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Hosts Bridget Lancaster, Julia Collin Davison and Toni Tipton-Martin offer a practical, no-nonsense and scientific approach to making a wide range of American recipes, from barbecue chicken thighs to Mississippi mud pie to parmesan potatoes. The hosts are joined by test cooks Morgan Bolling, Lawman Johnson, Christie Morrison, Ashley Moore, Bryan Roof and Kelly Song. dateline.us.description: When an Iowa woman is attacked while home alone with her three children, the confrontation turns deadly.

dateline.us.description: The investigation into a newlywed's disappearance focuses on her job as a CIA employee as a possible clue.

dateline.us.description: The investigation into the death of a Florida firefighter reveals a tale of secrets, lies and infidelity.

dateline.us.description: The survivor of a horrible attack is convinced police have the wrong suspect.

dateline.us.description: Against all odds, a young woman is found alive after an attack on her and a friend near Corpus Christi, Texas.

But problems with the K-19 arise that may lead to a core meltdown and explosion that will certainly kill all aboard, and possibly trigger a nuclear war. Vostrikov must choose between his orders and the lives of his men. (Thriller, Historical drama, War) - 2002

Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire. filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa. (Action, Thriller, Crime drama, Mystery) - 2015

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Code
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A veteran thief recruits a younger crook to help him pull off one final job in order to repay his debt to the Russian mob. (Crime drama) - 2009

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Devil's Arithmetic
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Hannah Stern (Kirsten Dunst), an American-born Jewish adolescent, is uninterested in the culture, faith and customs of her relatives; however, Hannah begins to reevaluate her heritage when she has a supernatural experience that transports her back to a Nazi death camp in 1941. There, she meets a young girl named Rivkah (Brittany Murphy), a fellow captive in the camp. As Rivkah and Hannah struggle to survive in the face of daily atrocities, they form an unbreakable bond. (Drama, Fantasy, War) - 1999

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Blind Horizon
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Found in the New Mexico desert with a head wound and total amnesia, Frank Kavanaugh (Val Kilmer) is brought to a hospital. When he recovers some of his memory, he begins raving about an upcoming assassination attempt on the president. Despite the man's unstable state, Sheriff Jack Kolb (Sam Shepard) is troubled by Frank's story. Discovering the truth grows more complicated when Chloe Richards (Neve Campbell) arrives and claims to be Frank's fiancée, even though he has no memory of her. (Drama, Thriller, Mystery) - 2004

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Prom Night
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: This slasher movie follows a relentless killer who is out to avenge the death of a young girl who died after being bullied and teased by four of her classmates. Now high-school students, the guilt-ridden kids have kept their involvement a secret, but when they start being murdered, one by one, it's clear that someone knows the truth. Also coping with the past are members of the dead girl's family, most notably her prom-queen sister, Kim Hammond. (Horror, Thriller) - 1980

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Long Walk Home
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Odessa Cotter needs to get to work as a nanny in the home of the affluent Miriam Thompson, but she refuses to take the bus. Odessa is participating in the Montgomery bus boycott, protesting against the inequality between blacks and whites, so Miriam decides to offer Odessa a ride to work every day. Though the community and Miriam's husband insist she not get involved, the relationship between Miriam and Odessa has already changed for the better. (Historical drama) - 1990

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A boy (Julian Dennison) and his foster father (Sam Neill) become the subjects of a manhunt after they get stranded in the New Zealand wilderness. (Comedy, Adventure) - 2016

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Cold Blood
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A legendary retired hit man (Jean Reno) lives in isolation in the barren North American wilderness. When he rescues a woman from a snowmobiling accident, he soon discovers that she's harboring a secret that forces him to return to his lethal ways. (Action, Thriller) - 2019

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Straight A's
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: At the behest of his mother's ghost, an addict (Ryan Phillippe) returns to his Louisiana home, where he must confront an ex-lover (Anna Paquin) who is now married to his brother. (Romantic comedy) - 2013

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: I'm Charlie Walker
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: In 1971 two oil tankers collide off the coast of San Francisco, spilling millions of gallons of crude oil and creating an environmental disaster. Against all odds, trucking and construction entrepreneur Charlie Walker secures a lucrative contract to clean the coastline. However, he also finds himself fighting institutional racism from the very company that hired him. (Drama) - 2022

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Jack's Back
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: In a sickening coincidence -- or a sinister homage to actual crimes -- women are being murdered in Los Angeles 100 years after Jack the Ripper terrorized London. Police think John Westford, a young doctor, is the murderer, and when he's found hanging from a noose, authorities believe his apparent suicide is a tacit admission of guilt. But his twin brother, Rick (also Spader), insists John was killed, and, when it appears Rick is right, the investigation takes a stunning turn. (Thriller, Mystery, Crime drama) - 1988

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Mysteria
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Aleister Bain (Robert Miano), a whiskey-soaked and washed-up Hollywood screenwriter, desperately struggles to finish a script. (Mystery) - 2011

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Getaway
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Doc and Carol McCoy are married criminals looking for a high-paying score. When Doc ends up in a Mexican prison, Carol tells mob boss Jack Benyon that Doc will work for him if Benyon can free him from prison. Benyon hires Doc to rob a dog track, but after the heist goes terribly wrong, Doc and Carol escape with the cash. With a bitter thief and Benyon's hired help on their trail, Doc and Carol must fight to survive. (Action, Adventure, Crime drama, Thriller) - 1994

hdnetmovies.us.title: The Great Escape
hdnetmovies.us.description: Imprisoned during World War II in a German POW camp, a group of Allied soldiers are intent on breaking out, not only to escape, but also to draw Nazi forces away from battle to search for fugitives. Among the prisoners determined to escape are American Captain Virgil Hilts and British Squadron Leader Roger Bartlett. Outwitting their captors by digging a tunnel out of the prison grounds, the soldiers find the stakes much higher when escape becomes a reality. (War, Drama) - 1963

hdnetmovies.us.title: Comes a Horseman
hdnetmovies.us.description: Determined single woman Ella Connors (Jane Fonda) struggles to maintain her ranch despite constant attempts by Jacob "J.W." Ewing (Jason Robards), the aging owner of the neighboring ranch, to coerce her into selling. When oil companies begin pressuring both ranchers to allow drilling, Ella's position becomes even more perilous. Though Ella thinks she's scrappy enough to fight them on her own, her chances get better with the arrival of hunky war veteran Frank "Buck" Athearn (James Caan). (Western) - 1978

hdnetmovies.us.title: Ride in the Whirlwind
hdnetmovies.us.description: Cowboys Wes (Jack Nicholson), Vern (Cameron Mitchell) and Otis (Tom Filer) are journeying through Texas when they have the unfortunate luck of meeting a gang of robbers who have just held up a stagecoach and lynched the driver. The local sheriff's posse surrounds them before they can get away, and Wes and his friends are unable to convince the lawmen they're not part of the gang. After a fierce shootout, Wes and Vern flee -- with the vigilante sheriff hot on their trail. (Western) - 1965

hdnetmovies.us.title: Support Your Local Sheriff
hdnetmovies.us.description: A small-scale gold rush erupts in a Colorado town after treasure is found in a grave. The area quickly becomes a magnet for criminals and other ne'er-do-wells, but everyone is too intent on searching for gold to consider law and order. When Jason McCullough (James Garner), a clever and supremely laid-back gunslinger, wanders into town, he becomes the de facto lawman, aided by local eccentric Jake (Jack Elam). McCullough's ingenuity is tested, however, when he runs afoul of the tough Danby gang. (Western, Comedy) - 1969

hdnetmovies.us.title: Support Your Local Gunfighter
hdnetmovies.us.description: When traveling con man Latigo Smith (James Garner) drifts into a small Western town, he decides to take advantage of a local rivalry between gold-mining factions. Recruiting the shifty Jug May (Jack Elam) to pose as a notorious gunfighter, Smith sets his scheme in motion, while also taking time to romance the lovely Patience Barton (Suzanne Pleshette). However, after his ruse is uncovered, Smith incurs the wrath of the real hired gun, among others, leading to a big shoot-out. (Western, Comedy) - 1971

hdnetmovies.us.title: Sam Whiskey
hdnetmovies.us.description: Great gambler Sam Whiskey (Burt Reynolds) has got his hands on a heist job that's pretty outrageous, even by Wild West standards. A drop-dead-gorgeous woman (Angie Dickinson) wants to quietly give back the gold her husband had stolen, now that he's dead. She approaches Sam to retrieve the gold from the bottom of a river and smuggle it back into the mint. The widow's beauty, and the nice sum she promises him, leave Sam powerless to resist the preposterous proposal. (Western, Comedy) - 1969

hdnetmovies.us.title: Battle of Britain
hdnetmovies.us.description: At a seminal moment in World War II, British Air Chief Marshal Sir Hugh Dowding (Laurence Olivier) must rally his outnumbered pilots against Hitler's feared Luftwaffe. Besieged by German bombing runs, the Brits counter with an aggressive air campaign of their own. Within months, the Nazis find themselves on the run, thanks to Dowding's tactical genius and the work of talented squadron leaders (Michael Caine, Christopher Plummer) and other brave patriots. (War, Action, Drama) - 1969

network.us.title: Chicago P.D. - Equal Justice
network.us.description: After a seemingly innocent young man is gunned down in the street, the team works to bring in the suspected culprit, but the case is more complex than it appears; the grief-stricken father is determined to do his own undercover work. (Drama)

network.us.title: Chicago P.D. - Instinct
network.us.description: After a series of deadly ambushes, the team goes undercover to bring down a dangerous new drug dealer who is determined to push out the competition; Ruzek's informant proves to be a loose cannon, which could upset the whole operation. (Drama)

network.us.title: Chicago P.D. - Protect and Serve
network.us.description: Ruzek and Atwater are tasked with making an arrest after a high-profile shooting; the situation becomes complicated when it's clear someone doesn't want them to make it back to the station. (Drama)

network.us.title: Chicago P.D. - Impossible Dream
network.us.description: When a local business owner is gunned down in his shop, it becomes personal for Atwater, who patrolled the neighborhood as a young cop; Dep. Supt. Samantha Miller comes to Voight with a special request about Andre Cooper. (Drama)

network.us.title: 9-1-1 - No Place Like Home
network.us.description: When it finally looks like Hen and Karen may get their foster license back, they are hit with another obstacle; the 118 races to the aid of a cheerleader involved in an infield collision. (Drama)

network.us.title: 9-1-1 - Masks
network.us.description: The 118 is once again working on the spookiest night of the year and missing out on all the tricks and treats; Buck's Halloween decorations become a little scarier than he had hoped. (Drama, Hallowe'en)

network.us.title: 9-1-1 - Confessions
network.us.description: When a toddler falls down a pipe and becomes trapped, the 118 must rely on more than their skills to rescue him; old wounds are opened when members of the 118 race to the aid of a man dealing with a divorce. (Drama)

network.us.title: 9-1-1 - Hotshots
network.us.description: When Athena is assigned a rookie to mentor, she begins to question her own abilities. (Drama)

network.us.title: 9-1-1 - Reentry
network.us.description: As Athena and Hen navigate their way back home, Athena will be forced to confront what it means to live without Bobby. (Drama)

network.us.title: 9-1-1 - Día de los Muertos
network.us.description: The 118's beliefs are put to the test as they respond to emergency calls involving a jack-o'-lantern and a few more jump scares than they were expecting on Halloween. (Drama, Hallowe'en)

network.us.title: 9-1-1 - Family History
network.us.description: Athena must revisit a painful part of her past when answering a call for help; the 118 takes a big step forward. (Drama)

network.us.title: 9-1-1 - Panic
network.us.description: A series of ransomware threats leads to emergencies for the 118, including a helicopter crash at a hospital and an air traffic control tower system failure; the case of the realtor serial rapist goes to trial. (Drama)

network.us.title: 9-1-1 - Desperate Times
network.us.description: The 118 springs into action when a citywide blackout and a record heat wave causes mayhem in Los Angeles; Chimney confides in Hen about Maddie's condition; Athena's worst nightmare comes true. (Drama)

network.us.title: 9-1-1 - Desperate Measures
network.us.description: As the citywide blackout continues to cause mayhem in Los Angeles, Athena races to save her family from a tragedy; Eddie must make a difficult choice about his future; Maddie makes a life-changing decision. (Drama)

network.us.title: 9-1-1 - Home and Away
network.us.description: A truck crashes into a high school homecoming parade; Athena and Michael try to help Harry in the aftermath of his kidnapping; May is intimidated by a returning call center legend; Bobby gives a devastated Chimney advice regarding Maddie. (Drama)

network.us.title: Dateline - Slow Burn
network.us.description: When a fire erupts at a New Jersey mansion, authorities find four family members dead; after detectives uncover a second fire nearby, they discover a shocking connection between the blazes, exposing a web of deception within the family. (News Magazine, Documentary)

network.us.title: Dateline - Hit List
network.us.description: New details come to light in an alleged murder-for-hire plot targeting a former NYC police officer's husband; the officer's ex-boyfriend and other insiders close to the case speak out in exclusive TV interviews. (News Magazine, Documentary)

network.us.title: Dateline - Hit List
network.us.description: New details come to light in an alleged murder-for-hire plot targeting a former NYC police officer's husband; the officer's ex-boyfriend and other insiders close to the case speak out in exclusive TV interviews. (News Magazine, Documentary)

network.us.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit - Obscene
network.us.description: The son of an outspoken critic becomes the prime suspect when the star of a controversial teen show is raped in her trailer on the set. (Drama)

network.us.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit - Quarry
network.us.description: A tip leads Benson and Cragen to the body of a 7-year-old boy, missing since 1980, and the detectives think the new information was a ploy to help the suspected killer, on death row for another murder, delay his execution. (Drama)

network.us.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit - Game
network.us.description: Stabler and Fin investigate the brutal rape and murder of a prostitute, and the prime suspects turn out to be a group of teens suspected of re-enacting a favorite video game. (Drama)

network.us.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit - Hooked
network.us.description: The detectives discover that a murdered teenage girl was a prostitute and had contracted HIV while working on a pornographic film, which leads them to her killer. (Drama)

network.us.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit - Ghost
network.us.description: When a wealthy couple laundering money for South American drug dealers is murdered, former ADA Alexandra Cabot (Stephanie March) returns from witness protection to help solve the case. (Drama)

network.us.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit - Design
network.us.description: A distraught pregnant woman threatens suicide, claiming that her child is a product of rape, but when the case goes to trial, the woman's willingness to settle for cash makes detectives suspicious. (Drama)

network.us.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit - Blast
network.us.description: When an 8-year-old girl is kidnapped on her way home from school, DNA tests on the blood found in the abductor's abandoned van reveal she has leukemia. (Drama)

network.us.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit - Taboo
network.us.description: When a baby boy is discovered in the trash, Benson and Stabler use a bar T-shirt found at the scene to link the crime to a well-to-do college student. (Drama)

network.us.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit - Fat
network.us.description: A band of overweight teenage siblings attacks a gifted piano student from Harlem. (Drama)

network.us.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit - Informed
network.us.description: Detective Benson goes undercover to combat terrorist activities; a victim refuses a rape kit. (Drama)

network.us.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit - Clock
network.us.description: Stabler and Fin investigate the disappearance of two high-school students from a museum field-trip; Stabler meets his new partner. (Drama)

network.us.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit - Recall
network.us.description: Stabler and Beck (Connie Nielsen) are unable to build a case against a rape suspect until a new witness (Leslie Caron) steps forward. (Drama)

network.us.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit - Confrontation
network.us.description: When an assailant rapes his victim twice, detectives Stabler and Beck (Connie Nielsen) link the case to other victims of multiple rapes. (Drama)

network.us.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit - Underbelly
network.us.description: Stabler and Beck (Connie Nielsen) try to get a young prostitute to testify against her pimp (Michael Kenneth Williams) after a trio of murder victims with matching tattoos leads them to a teenage prostitution ring. (Drama)

network.us.title: Dodgeball
network.us.description: The owner (Vince Vaughn) of a gym and an overbearing entrepreneur (Ben Stiller) form dodgeball teams to compete for $50,000 in Las Vegas. (Movies, Comedy) - 2004

retroplex.us.title: Don't Wait, Django... Shoot!
retroplex.us.description: Django believes there is only one path for him to follow when he returns to his hometown and discovers his father has been murdered by a ruthless gang. - 1967

retroplex.us.description: Rancher Gene Autry tries to aid neighboring Navajos suffering from malnutrition, but he is opposed by a crafty and crooked trading post proprietor. - 1949

retroplex.us.title: Little Big Horn
retroplex.us.description: Two cavalry officers (Lloyd Bridges, John Ireland) lead a patrol to warn Gen. Custer about an ambush. - 1951

retroplex.us.title: Under California Stars
retroplex.us.description: Returning to his California ranch for some rest and relaxation, cowboy movie star Roy Rogers (Roy Rogers) finds himself drawn into battle with a dastardly group of horse rustlers. - 1948

retroplex.us.title: The Unforgiven
retroplex.us.description: A Texas woman (Lillian Gish) and her eldest son (Burt Lancaster) fight Kiowas over an adopted daughter (Audrey Hepburn). - 1960

retroplex.us.title: Niagara Niagara
retroplex.us.description: Two misfits (Robin Tunney, Henry Thomas) meet while shoplifting and set out on a mission that takes a quick downward spiral. - 1997

retroplex.us.title: Hemingway's Garden of Eden
retroplex.us.description: During an extended honeymoon in Europe, a restless wife (Mena Suvari) tests her husband's (Jack Huston) devotion by inviting a sultry Italian woman into their inner circle. - 2008

retroplex.us.title: Night of the Living Dead
retroplex.us.description: A ragtag group of Pennsylvanians barricade themselves in an old farmhouse to remain safe from a horde of flesh-eating ghouls that are ravaging the United States. (Horror) - 1968

retroplex.us.title: The Carson City Kid
retroplex.us.description: The Carson City Kid (Roy Rogers) stops stagecoaches traveling between Wild West mining towns, searching their mail sacks for letters addressed to Morgan Reynolds, the man who killed his brother. Discovering that Reynolds operates a saloon under the name Lee Jessup (Bob Steele), the Kid takes a job as the saloon's bouncer. While vying with Reynolds for the affections of singer Joby Madison (Pauline Moore), the Kid discovers a swindled miner (Noah Beery Jr.) who claims to be the Carson City Kid. (Western) - 1940

retroplex.us.title: Lights of Old Santa Fe
retroplex.us.description: In this musical western, Marjorie Brooks (Dale Evans) is the owner and operator of a rodeo that's an antiquated touring company on its last legs. Her business rival, Frank Madden (Richard Powers), offers to combine their operations if the lovely Marjorie will be his bride. Though she initially rebuffs his proposal, a canceled booking tips the scales and forces Marjorie to accept. But rodeo rider Roy Rogers (Roy Rogers) suspects Frank is behind Marjorie's troubles and sets out to investigate. (Western) - 1944

retroplex.us.title: Robin Hood of the Pecos
retroplex.us.description: A night rider (George "Gabby" Hayes) and his singing partner (Roy Rogers) send Texas carpetbaggers packing. (Western) - 1941

retroplex.us.title: The Trail Beyond
retroplex.us.description: Fresh out of college, American Rod Drew (John Wayne) is asked to assist in the search for missing people in Canada. Accompanied by Wabi (Noah Beery Jr.), his friend from school, Drew travels north, but quickly gets into a confrontation with a gang of French Canadian outlaws. When the bandits abduct the young Felice Newsome (Verna Hillie), it becomes apparent they're responsible for the other disappearances as well. Luckily, Drew and Wabi are there, determined to find and free the captives. (Western) - 1934

retroplex.us.title: The Cowboy and the Senorita
retroplex.us.description: Things go from bad to worse for singing cowboy Roy Rogers (Roy Rogers) and his trusty companion, Teddy Bear (Guinn "Big Boy" Williams), when, after losing their jobs at a local café, the pair are accused of having kidnapped young Chip Williams (Mary Lee) who, in reality, is merely a runaway who's been tagging along with the cowpokes. But amidst these problems, Roy and his partner decide to team up with the girl and her half-sister, Ysobel (Dale Evans), and search for some long-buried treasure. (Western) - 1944

retroplex.us.title: Sagebrush Trail
retroplex.us.description: Wrongly imprisoned for murder, John Brant (John Wayne) decides his only option is to escape from jail and clear his name by finding the true killer. After breaking out, he ends up on the run from Sheriff Parker (Bob Burns) and catches the attention of outlaw Bob Jones (Lane Chandler), who offers to let Brant into his gang. Needing all the help he can get, Brant agrees, but running with these bandits only gets him deeper into trouble -- while the real killer remains on the loose. (Western) - 1933

retroplex.us.title: Outlaws of the Plains
retroplex.us.description: An impressionable cowpoke, Fuzzy Q. Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), hears a voice claiming to be that of an old Native American, telling him the location of some hidden gold. Fuzzy does find gold, but the land has already been claimed by Nord Finner (Charles King Jr.). Finner offers to sell his claim, and Fuzzy is eager to buy. Then Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe), a friend of Fuzzy's, shows up and discovers that a gang of outlaws is behind a scheme to rob everyone in the area. (Western) - 1946

retroplex.us.title: Romance of the West
retroplex.us.description: Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean), along with his sidekick, Ezra (Emmett Lynn), oversees the peaceful coexistence of the Native American tribes with the white settlers of Antelope Valley. The treaty that binds the two groups is threatened when some of the town leaders learn that the Native American land contains rich deposits of silver. Eager to oust the tribes and claim the silver, the town leaders try to provoke an attack that would break the treaty. It's up to Eddie to stop them in time. (Western) - 1946

retroplex.us.title: Panhandle
retroplex.us.description: John Sands (Rod Cameron), a reformed outlaw living in a small Mexican town, learns that his brother has been killed in the Texas Panhandle, and he sets out to investigate. When he arrives, he's confronted by a trio of gunslingers working for Matt Garson (Reed Hadley), a local gambler and saloon owner. He also begins to court June O'Carroll (Anne Gwynne), Garson's secretary. John soon grows to believe Garson is responsible for his brother's death, leading to a final showdown. (Western) - 1948

retroplex.us.title: Border Feud
retroplex.us.description: A feud has broken out over control of a Nevada gold mine, and Sheriff Fuzzy Q. Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) realizes that he needs a steady hand by his side. Good thing Fuzzy is pals with Cheyenne Davis (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), an out-of-towner who specializes in fighting crime. Beckoned by Fuzzy, Cheyenne arrives just as local beauty Carol Condon (Gloria Marlen) is taken captive by one of the warring parties. Cheyenne and Fuzzy will have to act fast in order to free her and defuse the tension. (Western) - 1947

retroplex.us.title: Paradise Canyon
retroplex.us.description: Rough-and-tumble federal agent John Wyatt (John Wayne) receives an unusual undercover assignment: He must infiltrate the ranks of an Arizona-based medicine show. Wyatt's boss suspects the show's shifty-eyed proprietor, ex-convict Dr. Carter (Earle Hodgins), of running a massive counterfeiting operation. With the full cooperation of the local authorities, Wyatt poses as a sharpshooter and begins his investigation -- only to fall for Carter's beautiful daughter, Linda (Marion Burns). (Western) - 1935

retroplex.us.title: The Cowboy and the Indians
retroplex.us.description: Rancher Gene Autry tries to aid neighboring Navajos suffering from malnutrition, but he is opposed by a crafty and crooked trading post proprietor. (Western) - 1949

retroplex.us.title: Under California Stars
retroplex.us.description: Returning to his California ranch for some rest and relaxation, cowboy movie star Roy Rogers finds himself drawn into battle with a dastardly group of horse rustlers. Taking pity on Ted, a young man who was disabled in a riding accident, Roy offers him a job on the ranch. But Ted's stepfather, Lige, leads a gang of thieves posing as wild-horse wranglers, and their prime target is Roy's famous horse, Trigger, which they kidnap for ransom. (Western) - 1948

retroplex.us.title: Jericho
retroplex.us.description: Jericho (Mark Valley) wakes up with no memory, but it's apparent that he's quite skilled with a gun. He is befriended by Joshua (Leon Coffee), who appears to be his polar opposite: He's a black man and true believer in the Lord, whereas Jericho is white and doubtful of everything, especially himself. Side by side, they attempt to piece together the amnesiac's past, which may or may not have something to do with a robbery, and either way is somehow connected to a town that's also called Jericho. (Western, Mystery) - 2000

retroplex.us.title: Chappaquiddick
retroplex.us.description: On July 18, 1969, Sen. Ted Kennedy drives his car off of a bridge on Massachusetts' Chappaquiddick Island. The accident results in the death of passenger Mary Jo Kopechne, a 28-year-old campaign strategist who worked for Kennedy. The ongoing investigation into the mysterious events forever alters his political legacy and changes the course of presidential history. (Thriller, Historical drama) - 2017

retroplex.us.title: Niagara Niagara
retroplex.us.description: Two misfits (Robin Tunney, Henry Thomas) meet while shoplifting and set out on a mission that takes a quick downward spiral. (Drama) - 1997

retroplex.us.title: Double Whammy
retroplex.us.description: Ray Pluto (Denis Leary) has many problems. He is satirized in the tabloids as the "loser cop." His partner (Steve Buscemi) is starting to seem suspiciously attracted to him. A pair of screenwriters (Donald Faison, Keith Nobbs) across the hall keep bugging him for help. The superintendent of his building (Luis Guzmán) is stabbed by hoodlums hired by his own rebellious daughter (Melonie Diaz). To top it off, a sexually aggressive chiropractor (Elizabeth Hurley) may just be Ray's undoing. (Comedy) - 2001

retroplex.us.title: Live!
retroplex.us.description: Documentarian Rex (David Krumholtz) follows ruthless reality television producer Katy Courbet (Eva Mendes), a woman who will stop at nothing to revive the American Broadcasting Network's failing ratings -- and forward her own career. To the dismay of the government, Courbet approves a reality show that will become network television's first foray into snuff. In the first episode, contestants engage in a deadly game of Russian roulette for the chance at a multi-million-dollar cash prize. (Comedy drama) - 2007

retroplex.us.title: After Dark, My Sweet
retroplex.us.description: After escaping from a mental hospital, drifting ex-boxer Kid Collie (Jason Patric) meets an alcoholic widow, Fay (Rachel Ward), who entices him into performing maintenance work at her estate. When crooked Uncle Bud (Bruce Dern) joins the two, Fay's darker side begins to appear. Bud and Fay concoct a scheme to kidnap the son of a local wealthy family and have Collie carry out the dirty work, to which the troubled ex-boxer agrees, but he soon has second thoughts. (Crime drama) - 1990

smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S02E10 Radical & Resplendent Exploring the design and engineering stories behind D.C.'s Museum of African American History, the Montreal Tower and the Equinor building in Oslo. (Episode, Series, How-to)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Fix That?
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S04E06 Tunnel Vision Mike joins crews as they build the world's longest railway tunnel in the Alps, fixing gridlock through the infamous Brenner Pass by drilling, blasting and digging their way through the mountains. (Episode, Series, Documentary)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Fix That?
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S04E08 For-Everglades Mike works with the Army Corps of Engineers on a massive project to restore essential flow of fresh water to the Florida Everglades; he also joins scientists, python hunters and the Miccosukee Tribe to eliminate invasive species in these wetlands. (Episode, Series, Documentary)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Fix That?
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S02E03 Aquarius Reef Base Diving into retrofits on the world's only underwater habitat, where NASA astronauts train for space missions; Mike joins a crack repair team who breathe new life into this oceanic environment after a global pandemic shut it down. (Episode, Series, Documentary)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Fix That?
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S05E01 Afterburn In Southern California, crews rebuild after the 2025 wildfires, cutting firebreaks, repairing emergency water systems, hardening roads and power lines and building fire-resistant homes before the next firestorm. (Episode, Series, Documentary)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Fix That?
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S03E01 US Coast Guard: Safeguarding The Seas Mike helps fix the vessels that the U.S. Coast Guard use to keep the oceans safe; he replaces key parts of ship engines, removes a large crane from a buoy tender, and fixes a helicopter for a critical exercise. (Episode, Series, Documentary)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Fix That?
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S02E01 Powerships Mike Davidson heads to Brazil, where an offshore crew is racing the clock to set up giant power ships to deliver electricity to a country in desperate need. (Episode, Series, Documentary)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Fix That?
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S05E04 Stratolaunch In the Mojave Desert, crews prepare Roc, the world's largest airplane, for a tandem flight with a 747 by repairing its wing, inspecting landing gear and engines and training chase pilots for the mission. (Episode, Series, Documentary)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Ice Airport Alaska
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S07E05 The Cold Hard Count Witness wild weather, emergency landings, and animal invaders at Ted Stevens International Airport in Anchorage, Alaska, one of the world's busiest cargo airports. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Aviation)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Air Disasters
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S07E05 Hidden Danger In 1991, a Boeing 737 operating as United Airlines Flight 585 suddenly rolls into a dive and crashes within eight seconds, killing all 25 people on board. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Aviation)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Air Disasters
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S10E07 Murder in the Skies When Germanwings Flight 9525 crashes in the French Alps, investigators discover shocking truths about the co-pilot's mental health. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Aviation)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Air Disasters
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S05E08 Imperfect Pitch On 27 November 2008, an aircraft on a post-maintenance test flight operating as XL Airways Germany Flight 888T stalls and crashes into the Mediterranean Sea off the coast of France, killing all seven people on board. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Aviation)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Air Disasters
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S02E04 Panic on the Runway On August 22nd, 1985, 55 people died aboard British Airtours flight 28M when its engine caught fire as it accelerated. (Episode, Series, Aviation, Documentary)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Air Disasters
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S09E09 Edge of Disaster Atlantic Airways Flight 670 careened off the runway and became engulfed in flames. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Aviation)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Air Disasters
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S20E18 Courage in the Cockpit Devastating failures in the air put pilots to the test and shine a light on three feats of flying. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Aviation)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Air Disasters
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S12E09 Deadly Go Round When an A300 stalls and crashes just before landing in Japan, fears arise about the plane's complex automated systems. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Aviation)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Air Disasters
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S08E02 Testing the Limits On 26 May 1991, the thrust reverser on the number one engine of Lauda Air Flight 004 deploys in flight without being commanded, causing the aircraft to spiral out of control, disintegrate, and crash about 100 miles northwest of Bangkok. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Aviation)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Combat Ships
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S04E03 Hidden Figures Stories of historic Black struggle for equality in maritime combat; an enslaved powder boy who served during the French and Indian War; a Civil War gunner; the first African American to command a vessel with a fully integrated crew: Hugh Mulzac. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Military, War)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Combat Ships
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S04E07 Record Breakers A look at how technological advances over the centuries have led to bigger and faster combat ships and transformed maritime warfare. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Military, War)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Combat Ships
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S03E04 Gulf War Warriors A look at key naval battles that have taken place in the Persian Gulf over the last 50 years and the warships involved, from both sides of the conflicts. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Military, War)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Combat Ships
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S01E08 The Smallest Ships A look at the smallest ships of war and the major roles they've played over the centuries, including the 1776 gunboat built to stop a British invasion and the HA-19 sub. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Military, War)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Combat Ships
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S03E05 Sunk New high-tech investigations uncover what sunk a World War I cruiser, a World War II submarine, a British destroyer from the Falklands War, and more. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Military, War)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Combat Ships
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S03E06 Top Guns A look at how navy weapons have evolved over the centuries, from cannons to gun turrets to nuclear missiles and beyond. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Military, War)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Combat Ships
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S04E01 Courageous Captains Exploring maritime heroes who left their mark on history through their bravery and skill, including Larry Chambers, Ernest Evans, and Robert Smalls. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Military, War)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Combat Ships
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S03E08 River Raiders A look at riverine warfare from the Civil War to Vietnam and small but powerful combat ships. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Military, War)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Combat Ships
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S02E07 The Battle of Leyte Gulf It is considered the largest sea battle in history: the Battle of Leyte Gulf in WWII was three days of ingenious strategy and white-knuckle combat between warships, aircraft and kamikazes. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Military, War)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Combat Ships
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S03E03 The Battle of Incheon A portrayal of a crucial September 1950 military operation that helped the UN and ROK gain the upper hand over North Korea in the Korean War. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Military, War)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Air Warriors
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S09E02 Tornado An inside look at the Panavia Tornado's evolution from a Cold War low-level bomber to a high-level fighter-interceptor. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Military, History)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Air Warriors
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S09E01 Lancaster The inside story of the Avro Lancaster, the British bomber that was rushed into service to fight back against Nazi Germany. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Military, History)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Air Warriors
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S10E03 B-17 Flying Fortress The Boeing B-17 Flying Fortress is one of the most lethal bombers of the U.S. Air Force in WWII's European and Pacific campaigns; among other things, the plane delivered food to the German-occupied Netherlands. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Military, History)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Air Warriors
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S10E09 Stuka Dive Bomber A look at the rise and fall of the infamous Nazi dive bomber Ju-87 Stuka, an aircraft of World War II. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Military, History)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Air Warriors
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S06E08 Spitfire The Spitfire, the iconic aircraft of the Battle of Britain, will forever be remembered by a grateful nation and the dwindling numbers of pilots who flew her; it is still regarded as one of the best planes ever built. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Military, History)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Air Warriors
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S09E05 Little Bird The inside story of how the AH/MH-6 evolved over the decades to become an irreplaceable aircraft for the U.S. Military. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Military, History)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Air Warriors
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S10E07 Hawker Hunter The inside story of Britain's flagship super jet of the Cold War era, the Hawker Hunter, and its most thrilling flights during the late 20th century. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Military, History)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Air Warriors
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S09E03 F1-11 The history of the F-111 and how the fighter-bomber no one wanted went on to dominate both air and battlefields in the late 20th century. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Military, History)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Air Warriors
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S06E02 F6F Hellcat The brief but historic service of the Grumman F6F Hellcat and its instrumental role in winning the Pacific War. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Military, History)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Air Warriors
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S10E01 F-14 Tomcat The true story of the F-14 Tomcat, the military aircraft made famous in "Top Gun"; how it served as the US Navy's top carrier fighter for a generation. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Military, History)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Air Warriors
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S06E01 AC-130 The massive AC-130 provides unparalleled close air support to U.S. and allied ground troops. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Military, History)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Air Warriors
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S09E04 P47 An inside look at the P47 Thunderbolt and the critical role it played in both the European and Pacific Theaters of World War II. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Military, History)

tntwest.us.title: FBI - Ties That Bind

tntwest.us.title: FBI - Fallout

tntwest.us.title: FBI - Hard Decisions

tntwest.us.title: FBI - Payback

tntwest.us.title: FBI - Studio Gangster

(Crime drama, Action, Thriller) - 2020-01-28

tntwest.us.title: FBI - Legacy

(Crime drama, Action, Thriller) - 2020-02-11

tntwest.us.title: FBI - Safe Room
tntwest.us.description: After the police ignore a desperate father's plea for help, he abducts a billionaire's daughter and holds her hostage in a safe room until his own missing child is returned to him; Jubal puts his hostage negotiation skills to the test. (Crime drama, Action, Thriller) - 2020-02-18

tntwest.us.title: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
tntwest.us.description: Godzilla and the almighty Kong face a colossal threat hidden deep within the planet, challenging their very existence and the survival of the human race. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2024

tntwest.us.title: Kong: Skull Island
tntwest.us.description: Scientists, soldiers and adventurers unite to explore a mythical, uncharted island in the Pacific Ocean. Cut off from everything they know, they venture into the domain of the mighty Kong, igniting the ultimate battle between man and nature. As their mission of discovery soon becomes one of survival, they must fight to escape from a primal world where humanity does not belong. (Adventure, Action, Science fiction, Fantasy) - 2017

tntwest.us.title: Meg 2: The Trench
tntwest.us.description: Jonas Taylor leads a research team on an exploratory dive into the deepest depths of the ocean. Their voyage spirals into chaos when a malevolent mining operation threatens their mission and forces them into a high-stakes battle for survival. Pitted against colossal, prehistoric sharks and relentless environmental plunderers, they must outrun, outsmart and outswim their merciless predators. (Science fiction, Thriller, Action, Adventure) - 2023

tntwest.us.title: Godzilla vs. Kong
tntwest.us.description: Kong and his protectors undertake a perilous journey to find his true home. Along for the ride is Jia, an orphaned girl who has a unique and powerful bond with the mighty beast. However, they soon find themselves in the path of an enraged Godzilla as he cuts a swath of destruction across the globe. The initial confrontation between the two titans -- instigated by unseen forces -- is only the beginning of the mystery that lies deep within the core of the planet. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2021

tntwest.us.title: FBI - Behind the Veil
tntwest.us.description: When a bombing at a local restaurant leaves several injured or dead, including a congresswoman and someone close to Isobel, the team races to apprehend the suspect before another explosive goes off. (Crime drama, Action, Thriller) - 2024-04-02

tntwest.us.title: FBI - Phantom
tntwest.us.description: After an employee of the U.S. Army is shot in an industrial park, the team works to track down the killer who reveals a larger plot at play; Tiffany continues to struggle with the guilt surrounding Hobbs' death. (Crime drama, Action, Thriller) - 2024-04-09

tntwest.us.title: FBI - Best Laid Plans

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
